Willkommen bei der Ruhrbahn GmbH: dem größten Nahverkehrsunternehmen im Ruhrgebiet

Bei uns findest Du nicht nur abwechslungsreiche und zukunftssichere Arbeitsplätze in Essen und Mülheim an der Ruhr, sondern leistest auch einen aktiven Beitrag zum Klimaschutz. In einem familiären Arbeitsumfeld, das von Respekt, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und Wertschätzung geprägt ist, arbeiten rund 2.500 Mitarbeitende aus 42 Nationen in verschiedensten Berufsfeldern. Wir gestalten die Mobilität von morgen.

Die Ruhrbahn ist bunt. Wir beschäftigen Menschen - unabhängig von Religion, Weltanschauung, Alter, sozialer Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Nationalität, Geschlecht oder geschlechtlicher Identität: bei uns sind alle Bewerbenden herzlich willkommen. Die Ruhrbahn setzt sich für Chancengleichheit ein und fördert gezielt die berufliche Entwicklung von Frauen. Wir begrüßen ausdrücklich Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Migrationshintergrund und -geschichte. Schwerbehinderte Bewerbende werden bei gleicher Eignung und Qualifikation besonders berücksichtigt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Sicherstellung der Planung, des Betriebs und der Entwicklung sowie des Systemmanagements der Data Science Plattform
  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Betrieb skalierbarer Datenarchitekturen (Data Lake/ Data Warehouse)
  • Entwicklung und Wartung von ETL-/ELT-Prozessen sowie Datenpipelines zur Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen
  • Sicherstellung von Datenqualität, -konsistenz und -verfügbarkeit in enger Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen
  • Implementierung von Schnittstellen und APIs für den effizienten Zugriff auf Daten
  • Optimierung von Datenbank- und Speicherstrukturen hinsichtlich Performance, Sicherheit und Kosten
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Data Scientist und Fachbereichen zur Bereitstellung geeigneter Datenstrukturen für Analysen und Modelle
  • Dokumentation der Datenlandschaft, Datenflüsse und technischen Lösungen

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Fachrichtung Informatik oder eine abgeschlossene IT-technische Ausbildung in Verbindung mit einer Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker (w/m/d) inkl. mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung in der Programmierung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse mit SQL/Oracle Datenbanken sowie in den Programmiersprachen Python/Java und ähnliche
  • Gute Kenntnisse der Microsoft-Produkte sowie in Prozessautomatisierung
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Netzwerkkommunikationsprotokollen sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Unternehmensprozesse
  • Umfangreiche Erfahrungen im IT-Projekt-/Stakeholder-Management
  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit

Deine Vorteile

  • Zukunftssicherer und unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • FirmenTicket/DeutschlandTicket
  • Flexible Arbeitszeit/Gleitzeit
  • Mobiles Arbeiten
  • Alle weiteren Vorteile findest Du auf unserem Karriereportal

Kontakt

Wir haben Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann sende uns bitte Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (mind. Lebenslauf & Qualifikationsnachweise) mit Angaben zum frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin bevorzugt über unser Karriereportal.

Vorsorglich teilen wir Dir mit, dass postalisch eingehende Bewerbungen nicht zurückgesendet werden.

Bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

As Scope grows, we are looking for a data scientist with a strong affinity to technology, to work with us on our data models, data infrastructure and data analysis projects. Come and join us to build with us the European Rating alternative. Duties & responsibilities Architect and lead the implementation of data models and data pipelines. Drive the technological development of the QAM cloud infrastructure together with our DevOps team - be on top of latest developments in the sector and manage the adoption process Work on our code architecture and improve performance Manage the relationship with the IT teams and act as our tech ambassador Professional & personal qualifications Experienced (8y+) Python developer/data engineer Proficient in cloud computing frameworks and experienced in architecting cloud-based solutions for data pipelines Advanced knowledge of Python Experience in managing workflow orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow)Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases Interest and motivation to learn the practical insights of credit rating analysis Highly reliable and with attention to details Ability to work in a team and independently as a self-starter without close supervision. Self-drive and versatility are very important. Fluent proficiency in English is a must. Other European languages are a plus. Interested? descriptionHtml:
Scope Ratings GmbH is looking for a highly reliable colleague with strong technical and analytical abilities to join the Quantitative Analysis & Modelling (QAM) team.

QAM is responsible for the quantitative rating model development at Scope Ratings and provides quantitative support to the different franchises of the Scope Group. We build tools that support our rating analysts at various stages in the rating process, ranging from data analysis and data mining projects to numerical simulation engines.

As Scope grows, we are looking for a data scientist with a strong affinity to technology, to work with us on our data models, data infrastructure and data analysis projects.

Come and join us to build with us the European Rating alternative.


Duties & responsibilities

  • Architect and lead the implementation of data models and data pipelines.
  • Drive the technological development of the QAM cloud infrastructure together with our DevOps team - be on top of latest developments in the sector and manage the adoption process
  • Work on our code architecture and improve performance
  • Manage the relationship with the IT teams and act as our tech ambassador


Professional & personal qualifications

  • Experienced (8y+) Python developer/data engineer
  • Proficient in cloud computing frameworks and experienced in architecting cloud-based solutions for data pipelines
  • Advanced knowledge of Python
  • Experience in managing workflow orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow)
  • Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases
  • Interest and motivation to learn the practical insights of credit rating analysis
  • Highly reliable and with attention to details
  • Ability to work in a team and independently as a self-starter without close supervision. Self-drive and versatility are very important.
  • Fluent proficiency in English is a must. Other European languages are a plus.


Interested?

If this sounds like a journey for you, we look forward to learning more from your convincing application. Please note: For non-EU applicants, a valid work and residence permit is a prerequisite for this job position. Unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor relocation from outside of the EU at this time.


What we want to see

  • Current English CV
  • Copy of your university degrees and certificates
  • Criminal record certificate (can be provided at a later date)
  • At least 3 letters of reference (can be provided at a later date)


About Scope

Scope Ratings GmbH is part of the Scope Group with headquarters in Berlin and offices in Frankfurt, London, Madrid, Milan, Oslo and Paris. As the leading European credit rating agency, the company specialises in the analysis and ratings of financial institutions, corporates, structured finance, project finance and public finance. Scope Ratings’ credit risk analysis is opinion-driven, forward-looking and non-mechanistic, an approach that adds to a greater diversity of opinion for institutional investors. Scope Ratings is a credit rating agency registered in accordance with the EU rating regulation and operating in the European Union with ECAI status.


At Scope Group, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and fairness. We embrace people from all backgrounds, regardless of culture, ethnicity and gender. We ensure that our application processes are free from discrimination. By valuing each individual's unique background and perspectives, we strive to create an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute their best. Our dedication to equality and inclusivity reflects our belief that diversity drives innovation and success.

Du kombinierst technisches Know-how mit einem Verständnis für unternehmerische Zusammenhänge und treibst die AI-Entwicklung von Prototyp bis Produktionsreife.


DEINE AUFGABEN


  • LLM-basierte Features: Entwicklung und Integration von Lösungen auf Basis Large Language Models (z. B. RAG-Systeme, Chatbots, Text-Generierung).
  • Agentic Use Cases: Konzeption und Umsetzung autonomer AI-Agenten zur Prozessautomatisierung in Portfoliofirmen.
  • Machine Learning: Entwicklung algorithmischer Lösungen für spezifische Business-Anforderungen.
  • Data Engineering: Aufbau und Pflege von Datenpipelines, ETL-Prozessen und Dateninfrastrukturen.
  • Analysen & Sparring: Durchführung explorativer Analysen, Unterstützung von Investmentteams, Coaching der Portfoliounternehmen.


DEIN PROFIL


  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Python und gängigen AI/ML-Frameworks (z. B. PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain, Hugging Face)
  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Anwendung von Machine Learning Modellen und LLMs
  • Erfahrung mit Datenbanken, Cloud-Umgebungen (Azure, AWS) und Data Pipelines
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (Master/PhD) in Informatik, Physik, Mathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Feld
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Teamgeist und Begeisterung für AI


Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung im Finanz-/Investmentumfeld
  • Leidenschaft für den Transfer von AI in unternehmerische Praxis

  • Innovationsfreiheit: Viel Raum für eigene Ideen und technische Gestaltung
  • State-of-the-Art Tech Stack: Arbeiten mit den neuesten AI-Frameworks und Cloud-Technologien
  • Direkter Impact: Umsetzung von Projekten mit spürbarem Effekt auf Business-Prozesse

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Specialist Data Engineering

As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing AI & Machine Learning solutions that drive business value for our clients. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build scalable, high-performance data pipelines, and AI models that enable data-driven decision-making.

Your Impact

  • Design and develop AI & Machine Learning solutions to solve complex business problems.
  • Build and optimize data pipelines, ensuring scalability, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, business analysts, and engineers to deploy AI models into production.
  • Implement best practices in data engineering, ensuring data quality, governance, and security.
  • Utilize cloud-based technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure) to build and deploy AI solutions.
  • Automate data processing and model training workflows to improve efficiency.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends in AI, Machine Learning, and data engineering to drive innovation.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, AI, and machine learning.
  • Strong expertise in Python, SQL, and data processing frameworks (Spark, Kafka, Flink, etc.).
  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and big data technologies.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, ETL processes, and data modeling.
  • Experience in building and deploying AI models in production environments.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with a strong business acumen.

Set Yourself Apart With

  • Experience in real-time data processing and streaming analytics.
  • Knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD for AI, and model monitoring.
  • Certifications in AI, Machine Learning, or Cloud Technologies.

Additional Information

  • An inclusive workplace that promotes diversity and collaboration.
  • Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Flexibility to support work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family.
  • Generous paid leave and holidays.
  • Wellness program and employee assistance.

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Als Data Engineer übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle in der Entwicklung und Anwendung unserer auf Azure basierenden BI-Plattform. Sie verstehen sowohl die zentralen Fragestellungen unserer Kunden als auch die Bedeutung der Daten im Kontext der Geschäftsprozesse. Auf dieser Basis entwickeln Sie Daten-Architekturen, implementieren ETL-Pipelines und stellen BI-Reports bereit. Wir verarbeiten jedes Jahr Millionen von geschäftskritischen Belegen und Daten (u.a. für die Auftrags- und Rechnungsabwicklung) zwischen tausenden von Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen. Mit unserer FXM-Plattform ermöglichen wir Entscheidern, aus diesen Daten wichtige Schlüsse für strategische Entscheidungen zu ziehen. Ihre Rolle Sie entwickeln unsere Azure-basierte BI-Plattform vom Data Lake bis zum Power BI Report. Hierfür analysieren Sie Datenstrukturen diverser Quellsysteme und modellieren die BI-Architektur. Dabei legen Sie großen Wert auf Qualität, Konsistenz und Schutz bzw. Sicherheit der Daten. Ihr Ziel ist eine kosteneffizient skalierbare und performante Plattform, die Mehrwert schafft. Als Teil eines cross-functional Teams arbeiten Sie eng mit anderen Rollen bis hin zur Geschäftsführung. Ihr Profil Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Data Engineer, ggf. auch als Data Analyst oder Data Scientist. Insbesondere Erfahrung in der Implementierung cloudbasierten BI-Architekturen mit Azure. Kenntnisse in der Datenmodellierung, Entwicklung von ETL Pipelines und Reports in Power BI. Kenntnisse in ML/KI und DevOps Engineering mit Azure DevOps von Vorteil. Fließende Englischkenntnisse (B2+) und gute Deutschkenntnisse (B1+) erforderlich. Unser Angebot Unbefristete Anstellung mit regelmäßigen Gehaltserhöhungen. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Kranken- und Unfallversicherung. Fahrradleasing, Firmenkarte, Essenszuschuss, Deutschlandticket uvm. Interne und externe Angebote für lebenslanges Lernen und Wachsen. Flexible Arbeitszeitregelungen mit zwei Tage Home Office pro Woche. Moderne Ausstattung, höhenverstellbare Tische und grüne Terrasse. Gute Verkehrsanbindung, Tiefgarage, Mittagstische in unmittelbarer Nähe. Sommerfest mit Familie und Freunden, Weihnachtsfeier, Teamevents uvm. Kalt- und Warmgetränke, Obstkorb, gemeinsames Frühstück. Seit 1996 sind wir Pioniere der digitalen Transformation und strategischer Partner des deutschen Mittelstands. Mit unseren Plattformen bieten wir Lösungen für Produktkonfiguration, Online-Handel, Logistik, Belegaustausch und Business Intelligence. So digitalisieren wir hunderte Unternehmen mit tausenden von Standorten in Europa. Erfahren Sie mehr unter: https://www.integrated-worlds.com/de/karriere/

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

About Redcare Pharmacy:

As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy, Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy, collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision: “Until every human has their health.” If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values, join us and start your #Redcareer today.

About The Role

Are you ready to take on the challenge of building robust data solutions for cutting-edge Data & AI initiatives? As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be at the forefront of developing and optimizing data pipelines and architectures that enable Data & AI models to deliver transformative insights. Join us to shape the future of digital healthcare with data-driven innovation.

Job Description

About your tasks:

  • Lead the design and development of advanced data models in Tabular and/or Databricks to address company-wide analytical needs, including models supporting financial forecasting, cost control, and profitability analysis.
  • Develop and oversee the implementation of sophisticated Power BI Cloud dashboards that surface both operational and financial KPIs, enabling real-time insight into business and financial performance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Controlling, and Business Operations to align analytics with strategic and financial objectives.
  • Conduct in-depth financial and operational data analysis, identifying trends, tracking deviations, and providing clear, actionable recommendations to support leadership
  • Enhance decision-making processes across the organization by transforming complex data into compelling narratives tailored to financial stakeholders.

Qualifications

About you:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or Analytics Consultant, ideally with direct exposure to finance, controlling, or FP&A environments.
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI Cloud, with a strong understanding of financial data modeling and semantic layer optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, SQL, and Python, with proven capability in handling large datasets for financial analysis and reporting.

Additional Information

About your benefits:

Benefits

In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different site-specific benefits:

  • Sports: Stay healthy. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club so that you can take advantage of a huge variety of sport offers.
  • Mental Health: Get quick and professional help from psychologists of nilo if you feel overwhelmed in private or professional life. Anonymous and free of charge.
  • Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
  • Mobility: We provide our employees with a fully costed Deutschland Ticket which can be used at any time.
  • Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings.

Lead the design and development of advanced data models in Tabular and/or Databricks to address company-wide analytical needs, including models supporting financial forecasting, cost control, and profitability analysis.

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Controlling, and Business Operations to align analytics with strategic and financial objectives.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Economics, Finance, or a related field.

title: Postdoctoral researcher in Digitalized and Data-Driven Materials Discovery (F/M/D)
description: A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials at the interface between materials science and synthetic biology, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. The multidisciplinary component of our research requires intensive information and data exchange between multiple disciplines. We work on semantically structured data and interfaces, shared workflows, and contribute to engaging the growing ELM community in digitalized research. To coordinate and support the digitalization of the ELM community, we are seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Digitalization and Data Science (f,m,d)to work within the collaborative network Material Vital Hub, recently funded by the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR) in collaboration with the Material Digital Platform. The candidate will be part of a team working together with experimental scientists and research data management experts at INM-Leibniz Institute for New Materials, with experts in ontologies and data platforms at IFW-Fraunhofer Institute for Mechanics of Materials and with bioinformaticians at the University of Freiburg. Your roles Contribute to the digitalization of the materials/data development workflows of selected ELM use cases by developing code to create semantically annotated data structures. Development of metadata schemes for typical methods in ELM research which are transferable to electronic Lab Notebooks and data platforms of relevance for other researchers within the Material Vital Hub. Lead the development of ELM-dedicated ontology for interoperability within the Material Vital Hub in cooperation with researchers and Material Digital partners. Demonstrate application cases of Data Science to ELM research based on structured data from the Material Vital Hub. Support and promote digitalization of the ELM community within the Material Vital Hub in close interaction with Material Digital Platform and NFDI. Attend workshops and disseminate your work within the ELM community by presenting results at conferences and scientific events. Document your work and report to project coordinators and stakeholders. Your profile Ph D degree in materials science/engineering or related disciplines. Experience as experimental materials researcher in combination with modelling or data-driven methods is ideal. Previous experience as data steward, or previous work within NFDI Consortia or Material Digital Platform is of advantage. Experience in the ELM or the biomaterials field is of benefit. Interest in working with and for the digitalization of the ELM community. Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills. Very good communication skills in English. We offer An emergent hot research topic with multiple opportunities to contribute and interact with the growing community and contribute to its development at an early stage. Direct access to and high visibility in the ELM network at national and international level. An existing team with expertise and drive to move forward digitalization in ELM research. A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities. A community-oriented, multifaceted work with great scope for creativity. A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture. Strong support of training and career development towards an outstanding profile as data scientist in materials research. Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity. A family-friendly working place. A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible. The position is initially for 3 years. Interested? We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by February 15th 2026 via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de). The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications and aptitude will be given preferential consideration.
descriptionHtml:
A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials at the interface between materials science and synthetic biology, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. The multidisciplinary component of our research requires intensive information and data exchange between multiple disciplines. We work on semantically structured data and interfaces, shared workflows, and contribute to engaging the growing ELM community in digitalized research.

To coordinate and support the digitalization of the ELM community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Digitalization and Data Science (f,m,d)

to work within the collaborative network MaterialVital Hub, recently funded by the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR) in collaboration with the MaterialDigital Platform. The candidate will be part of a team working together with experimental scientists and research data management experts at INM-Leibniz Institute for New Materials, with experts in ontologies and data platforms at IFW-Fraunhofer Institute for Mechanics of Materials and with bioinformaticians at the University of Freiburg.

Your roles

  • Contribute to the digitalization of the materials/data development workflows of selected ELM use cases by developing code to create semantically annotated data structures.
  • Development of metadata schemes for typical methods in ELM research which are transferable to electronic Lab Notebooks and data platforms of relevance for other researchers within the MaterialVital Hub.
  • Lead the development of ELM-dedicated ontology for interoperability within the MaterialVital Hub in cooperation with researchers and MaterialDigital partners.
  • Demonstrate application cases of Data Science to ELM research based on structured data from the MaterialVital Hub.
  • Support and promote digitalization of the ELM community within the MaterialVital Hub in close interaction with MaterialDigital Platform and NFDI.
  • Attend workshops and disseminate your work within the ELM community by presenting results at conferences and scientific events.
  • Document your work and report to project coordinators and stakeholders.

Your profile

  • PhD degree in materials science/engineering or related disciplines. Experience as experimental materials researcher in combination with modelling or data-driven methods is ideal. Previous experience as data steward, or previous work within NFDI Consortia or MaterialDigital Platform is of advantage. Experience in the ELM or the biomaterials field is of benefit.
  • Interest in working with and for the digitalization of the ELM community.Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
  • Very good communication skills in English.

We offer

  • An emergent hot research topic with multiple opportunities to contribute and interact with the growing community and contribute to its development at an early stage.
  • Direct access to and high visibility in the ELM network at national and international level.
  • An existing team with expertise and drive to move forward digitalization in ELM research. A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
  • A community-oriented, multifaceted work with great scope for creativity.
  • A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
  • Strong support of training and career development towards an outstanding profile as data scientist in materials research.
  • Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
  • A family-friendly working place.
  • A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 3 years.

Interested?

We look forward to your application!

Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by February 15th 2026 via the online application system.

For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de).

The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications and aptitude will be given preferential consideration.

GATE Bootcamps are part-time, self-paced training programs - 100% online, that can be completed in ideally 1-2 months, thus suitable for students, working professionals, career switchers and job seekers. title: Cofounder of a climatech startup - Full Stack Developer/Data Scientist
description: All great stories start somewhere. Yours could start with an application. Carbon13 is looking for those ready to dedicate the next X years to building a climate tech startup that reshapes the baseline scenarios dragging us deeper into climate crisis. There’s no time for false starts. Join the programme, find your dream co-founder in just 8 weeks, define your problem space, and tap into the expertise of 400+ domain specialists, carbon experts, and their sharp-eyed entrepreneurs in residence. Show that your team is ready to transform entire industries and secure Carboon13's initial investment in just 5 months. Apply here. And learn more about Carbon13 here. Here you will find an overview of our upcoming Q&As. We're looking for software developers, data scientists, and/or AI/ML specialists to become co-founders of startups that will adjust economies for a net zero future. Your specialisation and skills on data and code are the core factors to really move the needle. With us you will find the right cofounder, whose strong entrepreneurial background will help you get what you build off the ground. Our mission: Save the climate and aim big - before it's too late. Carbon13 is the Venture Builder for the Climate Emergency. We are laser-focused on supporting founders solving for the climate, and the climate only. To do that, we ask every new founder on our Venture Builder to aim big, to build a solution with the potential to reduce carbon dioxide (or equivalent greenhouse gases) by 10 million tonnes per year - and all our support is designed to help you reach that figure. You like solving problems, so come build with us and solve this one.“As a scientist on the Venture Builder, yes it was great to join a group which also had lots of other scientists and engineers, but I was also taken out of my comfort zone and challenged by amazing entrepreneurs and commercial founders. That's what took it from an idea to a business."Yubiao Niu, Co-Founder & CTO @Nium Why participating? We bring together a bunch of diverse people with many perspectives. There are about 75 people in our cohort with strong science, business or technical backgrounds. One of these bright minds is certainly a suitable co-founder for you. The climate doesn't have time for us to waste on false starts, tinkering at the edges, or greenwashing. When you join one of our cohorts, you'll be welcomed into a community with hundreds of other founders and experters all working on solutions to save the climate. Real transformation doesn’t come from a single individual but unencumbered communities with original thought. We care deeply about the success of those who choose to take giant steps. And of course carbon:“One of the unique things that we are doing at Carbon13 is we are not expecting our founders to outsource this knowledge, we are very much training all of our founders, so they have access to the latest tools and techniques, so that they can assess their carbon mitigation potential, understand how to communicate it and of course be transparent in how they measuring it.”Carbon13 Co-Founder and Chief Sustainability Officer Dr. Nicky Dee Flexible programme framework Apart from nine in-person days in Berlin/Cambridge, you can do the programme from anywhere in the world. descriptionHtml:
All great stories start somewhere. Yours could start with an application.


Carbon13 is looking for those ready to dedicate the next X years to building a climate tech startup that reshapes the baseline scenarios dragging us deeper into climate crisis.


There’s no time for false starts. Join the programme, find your dream co-founder in just 8 weeks, define your problem space, and tap into the expertise of 400+ domain specialists, carbon experts, and their sharp-eyed entrepreneurs in residence.


Show that your team is ready to transform entire industries and secure Carboon13's initial investment in just 5 months.


Apply here. And learn more about Carbon13 here.

Here you will find an overview of our upcoming Q&As.


We're looking for software developers, data scientists, and/or AI/ML specialists to become co-founders of startups that will adjust economies for a net zero future. Your specialisation and skills on data and code are the core factors to really move the needle. With us you will find the right cofounder, whose strong entrepreneurial background will help you get what you build off the ground.


Our mission: Save the climate and aim big - before it's too late.

Carbon13 is the Venture Builder for the Climate Emergency. We are laser-focused on supporting founders solving for the climate, and the climate only. To do that, we ask every new founder on our Venture Builder to aim big, to build a solution with the potential to reduce carbon dioxide (or equivalent greenhouse gases) by 10 million tonnes per year - and all our support is designed to help you reach that figure. You like solving problems, so come build with us and solve this one.


“As a scientist on the Venture Builder, yes it was great to join a group which also had lots of other scientists and engineers, but I was also taken out of my comfort zone and challenged by amazing entrepreneurs and commercial founders. That's what took it from an idea to a business."


Yubiao Niu, Co-Founder & CTO @Nium


Why participating?

We bring together a bunch of diverse people with many perspectives. There are about 75 people in our cohort with strong science, business or technical backgrounds. One of these bright minds is certainly a suitable co-founder for you.


  • The climate doesn't have time for us to waste on false starts, tinkering at the edges, or greenwashing.


  • When you join one of our cohorts, you'll be welcomed into a community with hundreds of other founders and experters all working on solutions to save the climate.


  • Real transformation doesn’t come from a single individual but unencumbered communities with original thought. We care deeply about the success of those who choose to take giant steps.


  • And of course carbon:


“One of the unique things that we are doing at Carbon13 is we are not expecting our founders to outsource this knowledge, we are very much training all of our founders, so they have access to the latest tools and techniques, so that they can assess their carbon mitigation potential, understand how to communicate it and of course be transparent in how they measuring it.”


Carbon13 Co-Founder and Chief Sustainability Officer Dr. Nicky Dee


Flexible programme framework

Apart from nine in-person days in Berlin/Cambridge, you can do the programme from anywhere in the world. The rest of the programme is delivered remotely.


It is very important to us to make clear that you can also be a successful climatetech founder if you have children, care for elderly relatives, do voluntary work or have other obligations. We can't tackle the climate crisis if we don't involve multiple life circumstances on the entrepreneurial path. Our Venture Builder is desgined on that principle.


“There was people from all over the place. All different walks of life, ages, backgrounds and I think this was one of the great things that Carbon13 was able to bring together for me.”

Natalia Dorfman, CEO and co-founder of KITA from cohort 2 in Cambridge


From Food to Construction to Energy to New Materials to Carbon Capture

Carbon13 is sector agnostic so founders can explore ideas in any emitting industry. We tailor our support accordingly for science-based, deeptech or hardware ventures - whether it's support on team building, assessing carbon mitigation potential, go-to-market strategy, IP protection, fundraising, you'll be accessing a brains trust of hundreds of experts, peers, and partners.


More than 150 ventures launched through the programme and 71 ventures received our pre-seed investment, a total of £9Mio since 2021. More than two-thirds of these have already secured follow-on funding. Our ventures are working on technologies with great emission-saving potential, such as carbon negative concrete, methane capture, bioplastics, precision fermentation, quantum computing for materials discovery, green ammonia, green hydrogen, biochar or direct air capture.

You can view our portfolio of ventures here.


Working on a climate tech idea already?

The VC funding route is currently the faster and often surer route for launching complex projects with a high decarbonisation impact, which is why Carbon13 has been designed to give your venture the best possible entry point into this route. Our support is tailored to science-based startups with the ambition to reduce CO2e emissions by 10 million tonnes per year.

If you do not have an idea, you will either be supported to find an idea to develop which can significantly reduce emissions, or join a cofounder/team with strong insights into an emitting industry and together execute the implementation of their validated customer pain points.


Learn More

We are running a series of webinars available to everyone who would like to learn more about Carbon13 and how to build startups with breakthrough solutions for the climate. Our next one for developers and data scientists can be found here.


Carbon13 in numbers:

- £14+ million investment across 100 ventures since 2021

- 70% of our first 32 have already raised further funding

- 50% of the ventures are software, 50% science or hardware based

- 70 potential cofounders on every cohort

- 35 technical, 35 commercial cofounders

- 90% of each cohort forms a cofounding team within Phase 1

- 350 domain experts, carbon experts, entrepreneurs in residence

- 10 million tonnes of emissions every year. We only launch startups that have the potential to reduce emissions by 10 million tonnes.

Ob als Data Scientist, AI Architect oder AI Engineer - das Betätigungsfeld des AI Consultants bietet vielfältige, spannende und abwechslungsreiche Einsatzgebiete in einem sich dynamisch entwickelnden Innovationsthema. Werde Teil unseres wachsenden Teams und erweitere die ]init[ AI Consulting um einen weiteren AI Enthusiasten (all genders) an einem unserer Standorte in ganz Deutschland oder remote.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen aus dem Public oder Health Sector in Projekten zur Umsetzung von Digitalisierungsvorhaben mit AI-Bezug
  • Du berätst unsere Kund:innen zum AI-Potential in konkreten Anwendungsfällen (Use Cases)
  • Du analysierst die Ausgangslage aus der Datenperspektive und entwickelst konzeptionell ein Input-Output-Modell zur Lösung der Problemstellung der Kund:innen
  • Du konzipierst nutzenstiftende Lösungen, egal ob als ML-basierte Anwendung, GenAI-System oder auch regelbasiert: Der Fokus liegt auf der (Teil-)Automatisierung von Verwaltungsprozessen und einem konkrete Wertbeitrag zur Zukunftsfähigkeit des Staates.
  • Du begleitest, bei Bedarf hands-on, die Umsetzung der Lösung in einem multidisziplinären Team mit Projektmanager:innen, Entwickler:innen oder DevOps-Spezialist:innen
  • Du identifizierst und bewertest notwendige Komponenten, berätst zum Aufbau und Zusammenspiel dieser Komponenten und begleitest, bei Bedarf hands-on, die Aufsetzung dieser Komponenten
  • Du trägst aktiv und kontinuierlich zum teaminternen Wissenstransfer bei


Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Data Science oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Science (Machine Learning oder Generative KI)
  • Du verfügst über Wissen zu strategischen Entscheidungen zur konkreten Architektur von AI-Plattformen (u.a. Cloud versus On-premise, Microservices), sowie über technisches Verständnis zu Cloud-Infrastruktur und der benötigten Hardware
  • Du hast Anwendungserfahrung zum Thema Datenaufbereitung, Data- sowie RAG-Pipelines, auch im Kontext von unstrukturierten Daten
  • Du bringst Kenntnisse in den gängigen Skriptsprachen (wie z.B. SQL, Python, R) sowie Prompt Engineering mit
  • Du bringst Kenntnisse in Containerisierung, DevOps und MLOps mit
  • Es gelingt Dir auch komplexe Sachverhalte zielgruppenspezifisch auch für Nicht-Technologie-Profis leicht verständlich aufzuarbeiten und so für AI-Themen zu begeistern
  • Du hast Interesse an neuen Technologien und Trends im Bereich Machine Learning und Generative AI und hast einen guten Überblick über gängige Komponenten (inkl. Open Source)
  • Wünschenswert: Du hast großes Interesse an der Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors oder des Gesundheitssektors, politischen und gesellschaftlichen Themen sowie Spaß am Austausch mit Kund:innen und ein Gespür für ihre Bedürfnisse
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab

Eigne dir regelmäßig neue Kompetenzen an und wachse über dich hinaus, denn wir wollen, dass du gerne bei uns bist und dich nach deinen Interessen entwickeln kannst.

descriptionHtml:
JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Analyst to join the team. You’ll work closely with the Rewarding team, investigating how rewards impact retention and engagement. You will analyse user behaviour to understand what drives retention using correlational analysis and ML techniques, and simulate user journeys at scale. You will create frameworks, metrics and visualisations to quantify relevant signals, and design and manage the experimentation roadmap to improve our player experience.

We're looking for someone who's passionate about using mathematical methods to solve business challenges and thrives on tackling complex, ambiguous problems to drive measurable impact. You'll need to take initiative and work proactively, bring creativity to your problem-solving approach, and be eager to go beyond the numbers to truly understand what makes our players tick.

Job Requirements

  • Advanced degree in Math, Stats, Econometrics or similar scientific domain, or a bachelor degree with experience equivalent to advanced degree
  • At least 5 years of experience in an analytics role as a product analyst or data scientist focusing on consumer-facing products. Candidates with 3 years experience plus an advanced degree with relevant practical research thesis will also be considered
  • Experience conducting complex correlational analysis (stickiness analysis, churn analysis and detection, VIP analysis, fraud analysis)
  • Proficient in SQL and Python, including packages such as Pandas and Numpy
  • Experience with Machine Learning techniques for segmentation (K-means, clustering), regression, and classification
  • Experience solving complex optimization problems using analytical methods and/or learning systems
  • Comfortable conducting statistical analysis and modeling using statistical best practices
  • Experience defining and implementing metrics and building visualisations using BI platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase
  • Hands-on experience with data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to interpret complex data
  • Excellent communication skills and proven experience collaborating with business stakeholders
  • Experience with Monte Carlo simulations, Multi-Armed Bandit algorithms, XGBoost, SVD, or similar advanced techniques is a plus
  • Experience managing gaming economy or pricing for a B2C product is a plus

This job is not for you if

  • You don’t like solving complex problems
  • You don’t mind doing analyses whose results will be ignored
  • You don’t care about business goals and measuring impact
  • It doesn’t bother you to build tools that no one will use
  • You’re comfortable using methods without understanding the science behind them
  • You are not looking for an environment that challenges you
  • You don’t ask challenging questions

But if you love diving deep into complex data challenges and seeing your analysis drive real product decisions, we'd love to hear from you!

Job Responsibilities

  • Simulate user behaviour using tools such as Monte Carlo simulations to model player journeys at scale
  • Use Machine Learning algorithms for user segmentation, regression and classification tasks
  • Create frameworks and metrics that quantify the relationship between rewards, retention and engagement, with clear visualisations
  • Deep dive into user behavioural data to unearth patterns and inflection points connecting rewarding and engagement
  • Conduct churn analysis and create a churn propensity score
  • Plan, define, conduct and evaluate A/B tests to drive experimentation-led product development. Manage the testing roadmap
  • Think creatively to find optimal solutions to complex, often unstructured problems
  • Collaborate with Engineering teams to define the data we need to collect for optimal outcomes

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers
  • Employee Stock Options: Opportunity to join our Virtual Share Option Program (VSOP) and share in the success of an already profitable company
  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner nilo.health to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work
  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc., and free language courses with Chatterbug
  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Gympass gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution
  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed
  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it
  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.
  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from 20 different locations
  • Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

About Us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming - making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable Play-to-Earn ecosystem where players earn real value for their time, funded through a self-sustaining loop.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading loyalty gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Bootstrapped and headquartered in Berlin, we own and operate the full stack: the JustPlay app, adtech monetization, first-party games, and automated payouts. With a team across 20+ countries.

We’re helping shape a major shift in mobile gaming and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll have the freedom and ownership to build end to end, move with startup speed backed by veteran leadership, and ship work that reaches millions - in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

DATA SCIENTIST (M/W/D)


Unser Angebot

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit
  • Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (38h/Woche)
  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement: ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, Betriebssport, EgymWellpass, Jobrad, etc.
  • Sonderzahlungen wie Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld
  • Corporate Benefits und GivveCard
  • Berufliche Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Die Möglichkeit, spannende und vielfältige Projekte mitzugestalten und umzusetzen
  • Zusammenarbeit in einem motivierten Team
  • Ein angenehmes und unkompliziertes Arbeitsumfeld


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung von Algorithmen zur Detektion und Klassifikation von relevanten Signalen in den Daten unserer eigenen Messsysteme
  • Identifikation und Anwendung von Verfahren des maschinellen Lernens und der Mustererkennung zur Entscheidungs-unterstützung
  • Kontinuierliche Steigerung der Auto-matisierung unserer Datenauswertung
  • Entwicklung von Visualisierungsmöglichkeiten großer Datenmengen zusammen mit der Softwareentwicklung und den Anwendern in der Datenauswertung
  • Arbeit in Projektteams und Leitung von eigenen Entwicklungsprojekten im Bereich Daten und Algorithmik
  • Verifizierung, Validierung und Dokumen-tation von Algorithmen
  • Bindeglied zwischen Messtechnik, Softwareentwicklung und Datenauswertung


Deine Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich der Informatik, Mathematik, Physik oder in einer vergleichbaren Studienrichtung
  • Fundiertes Know-how in der Entwicklung von Algorithmen und der Anwendung statistischer Methoden zur Validierung von Modellen
  • Kenntnisse in mind. einem der Themen
  • statistische Modellierung
  • Mustererkennung/Maschinelles Lernen
  • Datenaufbereitung und -visualisierung
  • Scientific Computing
  • Sehr gutes physikalisches Verständnis zur Analyse von Messdaten, insbesondere aus dem Bereich der zerstörungsfreien Prüfung
  • Begeisterung für die automatisierte Datenverarbeitung
  • Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Programmiersprache, idealerweise Python
  • Lust und Spaß an der Arbeit im Team – bei uns unterstützt jeder jeden
  • Eigenmotivierte, strukturierte und selbständige Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse erforderlich
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse wünschenswert

descriptionHtml:
Senior SRM, Data Analytics Manager Fragrances (m/w/d)

Wir sind Coty, ein weltweit führendes Kosmetikunternehmen. Als Anbieter von Parfüms sind wir globaler Marktführer und Nummer 3 bei dekorativer Kosmetik. Unser umfassendes Portfolio mit unzähligen renommierten Marken wird in über 150 Ländern verkauft. Wir glauben an Beauty mit einem fortschrittlichen Leitbild und an Marken, die unsere Kunden inspirieren – egal, wo auf der Welt sie sind.

Erfolgreiche Marken im Luxury- und Lifestyle-Bereich zählen zum lokalen Portfolio. Die Kollegen (m/w/d) von HUGO BOSS, CALVIN KLEIN, GUCCI, BURBERRY, CHLOÉ und viele weitere freuen sich auf Dich!

FREUEN SIE SICH AUF

  • Work smart - Homeoffice Möglichkeiten bis zu 50%, Vertrauensarbeitszeit sowie flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung
  • Team - Positive Arbeitsatmosphäre und -kultur, geprägt durch Diversität, Miteinander und Spaß
  • Internationalität - Agieren in einem internationalen Arbeits- und Konzernumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und spannenden Projekten
  • Arbeitsumfeld - Moderne Arbeitsplatzgestaltung
  • Parken & Anbindung - Kostenfreie Firmenparkplätze sowie zentrale Lage und gute Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel

HAUPTAUFGABEN UND VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

Der Senior Strategic Revenue Management Data Scientist erstellt Datenmodelle, Analysen und Reporting, um den Aufbau einer datengetriebenen SRM Strategie zu unterstützen.

  • Entwicklung und Implementierung von datenbasierten Modellen zur Optimierung von Preisstrategien und Revenue Management
  • Erstellung interaktiver Dashboards und Berichte mit Power BI zur Visualisierung von Erkenntnissen
  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von AI-, Machine-Learning- und statistischen Modellen zur Preisoptimierung und Vorhersage von Markttrends und Kundenverhalten
  • Statistische Analyse großer Datenmengen in Azure Databricks und anderen modernen Cloud-Technologien
  • Erstellung eines Pricing & Promo Playbooks
  • Generieren von Insights aus Daten in Zusammenarbeit mit den Data Analysts und Data Engineers im Team
  • Schulung von Teammitgliedern und anderen relevanten Abteilungen in Bezug auf neue Tools und Prozesse
  • Präsentation von Analyseergebnissen an die Geschäftsführung

Schnittstellen und Führung:

  • Ansprechpartner für die Geschäftsführung für analytische Fragestellungen
  • Eigenverantworliche Teilnahme und Leitung von funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Projekten
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Category Growth/ Sales / Marketing/ Finanz und global Marketing und global & regional Trade Marketing Teams, um die Gesamtstrategie des Unternehmens zu unterstützen und datengetriebene Entscheidungen zu fördern.
  • Fachliche Führung des kleinen, neu entstehendes Teams aus Data Engineers and Data Scientists (on site und remote)

DER IDEALE COTY FIT

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Data Science, Mathematik, Statistik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Datenanalyse und Modellierung, insbesondere im Bereich Pricing und Revenue Management in einem international tätigen Unternehmen, idealerweise in der Konsumgüterbranche
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure Databricks für Big Data-Analysen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Power BI zur Datenvisualisierung und Berichterstellung. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Power BI Semantikmodellen und DAX.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL und Programmiersprachen wie Python und R
  • Erfahrung mit Data Modelling und Predictive Analytics
  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis von statistischen Analysemethoden und Machine Learning
  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, Problemlösungsfähigkeit und eine datengetriebene Entscheidungsmentalität
  • Teamfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Starke Messaging-Skills, um komplexe Sachverhalte auf den Punkt zu bringen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern nahe zu bringen
  • Projektmanagement Erfahrung inklusive Stakeholder Management
  • Unternehmerisches Denken und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

IHR WEG ZU UNS

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns über Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.

Ihr direkter Ansprechpartner für diese Position ist Natalia Zhurina.

ÜBER UNS

Coty zählt zu den größten Kosmetikunternehmen der Welt und führt ein renommiertes Markenportfolio für Duft, dekorative Kosmetik sowie Haut- und Körperpflege. Coty ist weltweit führender Anbieter von Parfüms und Nummer 3 bei dekorativer Kosmetik und vertreibt Produkte in über 150 Ländern auf der ganzen Welt. Coty und seine Marken engagieren sich auch für eine Reihe sozialer Initiativen und sind bestrebt ihre Auswirkungen auf die Umwelt einzudämmen.

Für weitere Informationen über Coty Inc. besuchen Sie bitte unsere Website www.coty.com/.

Wir von Coty schätzen die Vielfalt. Wir stehen für gleichberechtigte Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten, unabhängig von Hautfarbe, Abstammung, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Staatsbürgerschaft, Familienstand oder Behinderung.

descriptionHtml:
Organic Search ist für dich kein Bauchgefühl, sondern ein datengetriebener Prozess?

Dann wirst du dich in der aktuellen SEO-Landschaft vermutlich oft fragen:

“Warum wird hier eigentlich so viel geraten – und so wenig gewusst?”


Willkommen bei Hurra Communications, wo Bauchgefühl Urlaub hat und datenbasierte Entscheidungen regieren. Wir machen kein SEO wie 2015 – wir bauen zukunftsfähige Organic-Strategien für eine Suchwelt mit SGE, AI & Co.


Denn: Wer heute noch denkt, SEO endet bei Snippets und SERPs, verpasst die Party.

Wir bringen Sichtbarkeit dorthin, wo andere nicht mal hinschauen – mit durchdachten Hypothesen, eigenen Tools, AI-gestützten Analysen und echtem Impact auf organischen Traffic.


Wenn du SEO kannst – und Organic Search wirklich verstehst, gerne tief in Daten abtauchst, AI nicht nur testest, sondern intelligent einsetzt und unsere Branche mit uns weiterdenken willst: Let’s talk.


Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung smarter, datengetriebener SEO-Strategien mit Fokus auf nachhaltiges Wachstum – nicht auf heiße Luft

  • Research zu Suchintentionen, Content-Potenzialen & technischen Showstoppern

  • Dashboards bauen, Daten visualisieren, Insights ableiten – z. B. in Looker Studio

  • AI-gestützte Tools (nicht nur ChatGPT) sinnvoll nutzen – von Prompt bis Priorisierung

  • Hypothesen bilden, testen, optimieren – du bist dein eigener Data-Scientist

  • Kritisch denken, nicht alles glauben, was Tools sagen

  • Komplexes so aufbereiten, dass Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen gerne zuhören

  • Unsere SEO- & AI-Setups aktiv mitgestalten


Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

SEO tief im Blut:



  • Fundierte Erfahrung in SEO – mit klarem technischen Fokus

  • Onpage, Onsite, Offpage – du denkst in Systemen, nicht in Silos

  • Du bist sicher mit Tools wie Sistrix, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog & Co.

  • Du erkennst in einem Crawl mehr als “Fehler 404"


AI im Kopf:



  • Du bist neugierig auf AI, LLMs & was das mit SEO macht

  • Du verstehst, warum strukturierte Daten für SGE & Chatbots Gold wert sind

  • Du kannst Prompt-Logiken mit klassischer Keyword-Recherche kombinieren

  • Du bringst AI-Tests und -Ideen aktiv in Kundenprojekte ein


Data driven Mindset:



  • Du liebst Daten – und weißt, wie man aus ihnen echte Erkenntnisse gewinnt

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch, präzise

  • Du willst Prozesse verbessern statt sie nur zu verwalten


Consulting-Skills:



  • Du führst Kund:innen sicher durch Strategien & Entscheidungen

  • Du moderierst Workshops, erklärst komplexe Themen verständlich

  • Du nimmst Ownership und bist ein verlässlicher Sparringspartner


Businessblick:



  • Du hast immer auch die Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick

  • Du erkennst Potenziale & Cross-Selling-Chancen

  • Du willst nicht nur Projekte abarbeiten, sondern mitgestalten


Nice to have:



  • Pitch-Erfahrung & Lust auf Neugeschäft

  • Verständnis für Paid-Kanäle & deren Zusammenspiel mit SEO


Benefits

Was wir dir bieten:



  • 100 % Remote – arbeite, wo du willst

  • Flexible Zeiten – Hauptsache: ein bisschen Schnittmenge mit der DACH-Zone

  • Ein internationales, offenes Team mit Haltung

  • Ein SEO-Umfeld, das datengetrieben & AI-ready ist

  • Fokus auf Qualität & Impact statt Buzzword-Bingo

  • Viel Raum für Ideen, Verantwortung & Weiterentwicklung


Klingt nach dir?

Dann schauen dir bitte dieses kurze Video an:


https://www.youtube.com/shorts/X9A8EMJVwAA


Und dann brauchen wir von dir ebenfalls ein kurzes Video (2–3 Minuten reichen völlig). Bitte beantworte darin:



  • Wer bist du?

  • Was treibt dich im Bereich Organic Search / SEO an?

  • Warum passt du zu uns (und wir zu dir)?


Bewerbungen ohne Video können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen.

title: Data Scienctist
description: Wir sind Profis im Sachschaden: Seit 2001 unterstützen wir mit unserem Branchen-Know-How über 90 Versicherungen europaweit. Tendenz steigend. Große Namen vertrauen uns - mit unseren Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sind wir ein markt-führender Dienstleister im deutschsprachigen Raum. Als Teil der weltweit agierenden Solera-Familie setzen wir neben bewährten Standard-Technologien auch auf Künstliche Intelligenz – für innovative und hochspezialisierte Lösungen. Dabei arbeiten wir mit Menschen zusammen, die unsere Leidenschaft für hervorragenden Service teilen. Und wir wachsen weiter. Daher suchen wir ab sofort einen Data Scientist – Fokus Natural Language Processing*. In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du mit uns die Zukunft von AI in der Versicherungswirtschaft und setzt neue Standards. Deine Aufgaben:Mitgestalten statt nur zusehen: Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung von KI-basierten Produkten mit Schwerpunkt auf Natural Language Processing (NLP). Lernen und Wachsen: Arbeite eng mit erfahrenen Data Scientists zusammen, um Dein Wissen über Machine Learning, Large Language Models und moderne AI-Tools zu vertiefen. Produktentwicklung: Du wirkst an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung bestehender Modelle und bringst eigene Ideen für neue AI-Lösungen ein. Zusammenarbeit: In interdisziplinären Teams arbeitest Du gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus Data Science, IT und Fachabteilungen an realen Kundenprojekten. Technologieeinsatz: Du nutzt moderne Tools und Frameworks (z. B. Tensorflow, PyTorch, FAISS, Langchain, Hugging Face), um praxisnahe ML-Lösungen umzusetzen. Das bringst Du mit:Abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Erste praktische Erfahrung (z. B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder Abschlussarbeiten) im Bereich Machine Learning oder NLP. Grundkenntnisse in Python und gängigen ML-Frameworks (z. B. scikit-learn, Tensorflow, PyTorch, Hugging Face). Verständnis für grundlegende Konzepte des maschinellen Lernens, der Datenverarbeitung und Softwareentwicklung. Freude an Teamarbeit, analytischem Denken und der Wunsch, Dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch verhandlungssicher und besitzt sehr gute Englischkenntnisse Leidenschaft für Python: Wir sind „pythonic“ – Du auch? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen:Du erhältst eine unbefristete Anstellung. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Remote, Hybrid oder im modernen Büro im Herzen von Dresden mit ausgezeichneter Verkehrsanbindung. Wir bieten Dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und pünktlichen Feierabend. Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre mit netten Kollegen, frischem Obst, Getränken, Fitnessstudio und regelmäßigen Events. Wir bieten die Möglichkeit, ein Job-Rad über die Firma zu beziehen. Du arbeitest in flachen Hierarchien in einem professionellen, freundlichen und motivierten Team. Kurze Entscheidungswege Du erhältst ein attraktives Gehalt mit leistungsfördernden Bonuszahlungen. Jetzt bewerben:Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft von AI in der Sachversicherung. Wir freuen uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Angabe Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin per E-Mail an karriere@sachcontrol.de. Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Stellenanzeige das generische Maskulinum verwendet. Wir sprechen ausdrücklich alle Geschlechter an.

title: Projektmanager / Solution Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Über Scavenger AIScavenger AI ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden AI-Startups in Europa: VC-backed, frisch unsere Seed-Runde geraised, ausgezeichnet als bestes AI Start-Up in Deutschland. Wir bauen das Produkt, das Business Intelligence neu definiert, indem wir komplexe Unternehmensdaten in verständliche, präzise und vertrauenswürdige Analysen transformieren; damit jeder Mitarbeiter Entscheidungen treffen kann, ohne Datenexperte zu sein. Aufgaben Als Projektmanager / Solution Engineer bringst du unser Produkt beim Kunden zum fliegen. Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Business und Tech. Du verstehst die Anforderungen unserer Nutzer, übersetzt sie in Umsetzungspläne und koordinierst sowohl interne als auch externe Stakeholder. Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für Kundenprojekte: Vom Kickoff bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live. Du definierst Projektziele, Workstreams, Verantwortlichkeiten, Scope & Zeitplan. Du führst strukturiert durch Workshops, Onboardings und regelmäßige Status-Updates. Du bist die zentrale Kontaktperson („one face to the customer“) und sorgst für klare Kommunikation. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Product & Engineering Team zusammen, priorisierst Anforderungen und stellst sicher, dass Kundenthemen sauber ins Produktzurückfließen. Wenn es kritisch wird, kannst du auch mal selbst eingreifen, sei es bei Datenlogiken, analytischen Fragen oder kleinen technischen Anpassungen (z. B. SQL, Python, API-Checks). Qualifikation Idealerweise bringst du folgendes mit:Du musst kein Data Scientist sein, aber du solltest dich im Daten- und Software-Kontext wohlfühlen. Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Consulting, Solution Engineering, Business Analyticsoder Customer Success (B2B Saa S Umfeld von Vorteil). Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Moderationsskills (kundenseitig & intern). Fähigkeit technische Sachverhalte schnell zu verstehen und strukturiert zu erklären. Grundverständnis von Datenbanken / SQL und erste Erfahrung in Python oderausreichende technische Lernbereitschaft. Unternehmerisches, lösungsorientiertes Mindset Spaß daran, Prozesse zu gestalten, Dinge zu strukturieren und Ordnung in Chaos zubringen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Benefits Wir haben Büros in Berlin, Aachen & Wien aber auch Remote ist flexibel möglich. Der Start wäre ab sofort und wir hätten dich am liebsten Vollzeit. Wenn du Lust hast, eine Schlüsselrolle in einem schnell wachsenden AI-Unternehmen zu übernehmen, die Zukunft von Business Intelligence in Europa mitzugestalten und du Pragmatismus und Effizienz liebst, dann freuen wir uns, von dir zu hören.

title: Senior Data Analyst (Berlin)
description: At Born, we create AI friends. Friends that enter your life at the right moment. Friends that last for a lifetime, always there for you whenever you need them most. Because everyone deserves a great friend. We now have over 15 million users and are rapidly growing across our products. Since launching in 2022, we have released five apps, each reaching the top of the App Store worldwide. Our flagship AI friend is Pengu. Pengu is an IP-based AI character that lives between you and your real friends - you can raise it together, play games, chat, and watch it live its own life. Pengu has become the biggest AI character app with its own IP in the US. We have also launched a new AI social product in stealth that is already seeing outstanding adoption. We are backed by world-class investors, including Accel, Kevin Weil, Riccardo Zacconi, Scott Belsky, and Ilkka Paananen, and we have raised $25M to date. Tasks Data Analysis and Insights: Enable tactical and strategic decision-making by providing insightful analyses, developing predictive models, and creating dashboards. Predictive Analytics: Build and interpret predictive models to forecast Lifetime Value (LTV) and user behavior, optimizing marketing spend and strategies. A/B Testing: Design, analyze, and interpret the results of A/B tests to inform marketing strategies and improve campaign performance. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, user acquisition, and data engineering teams to understand data needs and deliver solutions that drive business objectives. Requirements Experience:3+ years in a role such as Data Analyst or Data Scientist with a strong emphasis on consumer app knowledge. Technical Proficiency:Strong expertise in SQL and experience with data analysis tools. Proficiency in a programming language (e.g., Python). Experience with DBT and cloud data warehouses is a plus. Predictive Analytics:Experience with predictive modeling techniques and forecasting LTV. Familiarity with machine learning concepts and algorithms relevant to marketing analytics. Data Visualization:Proficiency with visualization tools like Metabase, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI. Analytical Mindset:Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach. Ability to handle complex datasets and extract actionable insights. Communication Skills:Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders. Adaptability:Proven ability to deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Benefits Compensation and Stock Options: Competitive compensation and equity options. Your move, our support: Generous relocation bonus included. Openness: Flexible hybrid work environment. Prime Berlin Office: Our Berlin Mitte office boasts state-of-the-art amenities, including Apple Studio Displays and Herman Miller chairs. Full Commute Reimbursement: We cover 100% of your commuting costs. Gym Membership: Stay fit and healthy on us. Visa Sponsorship & Assistance: We support your visa process and guide you through all the paperwork. Supportive team: A team that values passion, openness, and having your back. Regular offsite gatherings: To celebrate wins, and build connections.
descriptionHtml:
At Born, we create AI friends. Friends that enter your life at the right moment. Friends that last for a lifetime, always there for you whenever you need them most. Because everyone deserves a great friend. We now have over 15 million users and are rapidly growing across our products.


Since launching in 2022, we have released five apps, each reaching the top of the App Store worldwide. Our flagship AI friend is Pengu. Pengu is an IP-based AI character that lives between you and your real friends - you can raise it together, play games, chat, and watch it live its own life. Pengu has become the biggest AI character app with its own IP in the US. We have also launched a new AI social product in stealth that is already seeing outstanding adoption.


We are backed by world-class investors, including Accel, Kevin Weil, Riccardo Zacconi, Scott Belsky, and Ilkka Paananen, and we have raised $25M to date.


Tasks

  • Data Analysis and Insights: Enable tactical and strategic decision-making by providing insightful analyses, developing predictive models, and creating dashboards.

  • Predictive Analytics: Build and interpret predictive models to forecast Lifetime Value (LTV) and user behavior, optimizing marketing spend and strategies.

  • A/B Testing: Design, analyze, and interpret the results of A/B tests to inform marketing strategies and improve campaign performance.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, user acquisition, and data engineering teams to understand data needs and deliver solutions that drive business objectives.


Requirements

Experience:



  • 3+ years in a role such as Data Analyst or Data Scientist with a strong emphasis on consumer app knowledge.


Technical Proficiency:



  • Strong expertise in SQL and experience with data analysis tools.

  • Proficiency in a programming language (e.g., Python).

  • Experience with DBT and cloud data warehouses is a plus.


Predictive Analytics:



  • Experience with predictive modeling techniques and forecasting LTV.

  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts and algorithms relevant to marketing analytics.


Data Visualization:



  • Proficiency with visualization tools like Metabase, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.


Analytical Mindset:



  • Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach.

  • Ability to handle complex datasets and extract actionable insights.


Communication Skills:



  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.


Adaptability:



  • Proven ability to deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.


Benefits

  • Compensation and Stock Options: Competitive compensation and equity options.

  • Your move, our support: Generous relocation bonus included.

  • Openness: Flexible hybrid work environment.

  • Prime Berlin Office: Our Berlin Mitte office boasts state-of-the-art amenities, including Apple Studio Displays and Herman Miller chairs.

  • Full Commute Reimbursement: We cover 100% of your commuting costs.

  • Gym Membership: Stay fit and healthy on us.

  • Visa Sponsorship & Assistance: We support your visa process and guide you through all the paperwork.

  • Supportive team: A team that values passion, openness, and having your back.

  • Regular offsite gatherings: To celebrate wins, and build connections.

descriptionHtml:
Short Facts

With our AI-powered, fully automated optimization and trading platform for flexible energy assets — from grid-scale batteries to virtual power plants — we ensure that energy is stored when it’s abundant and released into the grid when it’s needed. By actively trading electricity, we help stabilize the grid and maximize returns for asset owners, accelerating the transition to a clean energy future.

To drive the smart and sustainable energy future, we are looking for a forward-thinking and experienced Energy Data Analyst Lead to lead Entrix’s analytics initiatives, shape company-wide learning from data, and contribute to the success of our core product.

Short Facts:

  • Location: Munich, Germany
  • Employment Type: Full-Time, indefinite term
  • Salary Range: €100,000 – €115,000 gross per year, depending on experience
  • Working mode: Office setup
  • Language Requirement: C1 English (German is a plus)

Your Responsibilities

As a Energy Data Analyst Lead, you will play a leading role in shaping Entrix’s analytics strategy, driving cross-functional alignment, and amplifying business impact through data. You will act as the lead for the data analytics team at Entrix. You will be the mentor, and trusted advisor, guiding others through expertise, collaboration, and influence.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead product & market analytics: Analyze trading algorithm performance, market behavior to provide actionable insights to improve performance.
  • Drive strategic insights: Partner with leadership on data-driven decision-making, providing actionable recommendations that shape Entrix’s product roadmap and business priorities.
  • Mentor & lead: Lead the analysts in your team through mentorship and technical leadership, fostering a culture of analytical excellence and growth
  • Align cross-functional analytics: Coordinate analytics efforts across teams, ensuring priorities are aligned and there is effective cross-functional collaboration across product, engineering, data science, and commercial domains.
  • Enable data-driven learning: Develop and maintain analytics frameworks, KPIs, and tooling. Ensure insights are embedded into processes, promoting continuous learning and operational excellence.
  • Engage with stakeholders: Being able to jump into deep-dives on certain findings with (external) stakeholders, tailoring insights to match the stakeholder needs

Your Profile

Mandatory Requirements

  • Degree in Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field.
  • 7+ years of experience as (a mix of) data analyst, data scientist, software engineering, energy trader or researcher, ideally within energy, trading, or SaaS sectors.
  • Deep expertise in energy markets and flexibility optimization.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and applied statistical methods (hypothesis testing, A/B testing, time series analysis, descriptive & predictive analytics).
  • Strong understanding of cloud development principles and core AWS components.
  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional analytical projects.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders at all levels (including executive and customer-facing roles).
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Skills that set you apart

  • Experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups.
  • Hands-on knowledge of trading algorithms, optimization models, or market simulations.
  • Advanced data visualization capabilities (Grafana, Plotly, custom dashboards).
  • Strong technical foundation in energy storage systems (especially BESS).
  • Proven experience in creation of analytical platforms in close collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with software development best practices.

This role is not a fit if…

  • You are mainly experienced with no-code BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) without strong coding skills.
  • You are not passionate about energy markets and their complexities.
  • You are uncomfortable working with ambiguity, rapid experimentation, and evolving priorities.

Your Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation Package: Including salary and benefits
  • Professional Development: Annual development budget of 3,000 € for coachings, trainings, books, etc.
  • Public Transportation Subsidy: Monthly subsidy to your public transport ticket
  • Health & Sport Subsidy: Company subsidised sports facilities membership
  • Lunch/Dinner Allowance Vouchers: Allowance for meals on working days as digital meal vouchers
  • Work Equipment: MacBook or Windows Laptop and ergonomic workplace
  • Regular Team Events: Knowledge Sessions, Afterwork, Sports, Offsites, Halloween, Pride Month, etc.

A Short Note from Your Future Lead

Bastian Hechenrieder - Chief Product Officer

Hi there!

My name is Bastian, and I am the Chief Product Officer (CPO) at Entrix. My team and I are excited to extend our team and we look forward to receiving your application.

Early in my career, I developed a fascination for the energy industry and mathematical optimization. Entrix is the perfect place for me to leverage algorithms and technology to drive the energy transition forward.

As a leader, building relationships based on trust is paramount for me. I strive to provide an environment where you can excel and find opportunities for growth and development. I strongly believe that we succeed as a team and that fun and positivity are key drivers of success in a sustainable workplace.

I value ownership and proactivity within my team. We support each other and strive for excellent results. Let’s make the energy transition happen together! Thank you for considering joining us on our exciting journey.

Best regards,

Bastian

Your Contact in our People Team

Your contact person is Nagihan Bal (nagihan.bal@entrixenergy.com)

If you have any questions, feel free to send us an email at talent@entrixenergy.com

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

About Us

We are an energy trader and market leader for trading flexible energy systems in Europe.

Beyond AI-powered trading, Entrix provides innovative solutions for long-term revenue security and grid-supportive battery operation. With our full-service package, we support customers throughout every project phase – from technical design and integration, to continuous optimization, all the way to 24/7 operational support. That includes adapting to changing market conditions and unlocking new revenue opportunities.

With more than 2.3 GW and 38 battery storage assets under contract, Entrix is active in Germany, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal, with offices in Munich, Warsaw, Milan, and Madrid. Since 2022, Entrix has been pioneering battery optimization in Germany by managing one of the country’s first large-scale storage projects – and is now the trusted partner of leading infrastructure players such as Encavis, MEAG (Munich Re), as well as a wide range of local utilities.
