About Staffline Solutions


Staffline Solutions is an innovative talent solutions platform committed to connecting businesses with exceptional candidates. As part of our expansion into Data Analytics, we are offering a structured internship program for motivated individuals eager to build a career in data-driven decision-making.


Internship Summary

Join our analytics team and gain practical experience working on real business datasets. You will develop dashboards, conduct data analysis, and help generate actionable insights that contribute to business growth in a dynamic tech environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, and preprocess data to ensure accuracy and usability
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and patterns
  • Create interactive dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or Excel
  • Perform SQL queries and support basic statistical analyses
  • Maintain documentation of processes and workflows to ensure data reliability


Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Current student or recent graduate in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or related fields
  • Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets and SQL
  • Basic programming knowledge in Python or R
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail


Additional Advantages

  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, machine learning concepts, or hackathons
  • Relevant certifications (Google Data Analytics Certificate, Microsoft Data Analyst Associate, etc.)

  • Real-world project experience with structured mentorship
  • Personalized one-on-one guidance from industry professionals
  • Internship completion certificate and letter of recommendation
  • Opportunity for pre-placement offer (PPO) based on performance


Selection Process

  • Online application submission
  • Aptitude assessment
  • Technical and managerial interviews
  • Offer confirmation and onboarding


Additional Information

This is a paid internship opportunity. Staffline Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or other protected status.

descriptionHtml:
About The Job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: Machine Learning Engineer

Type: Contract

Compensation: $14/hour

Location: Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable ML pipelines for model training, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
  • Build and fine-tune deep learning models for reasoning, code generation, and real-world decision-making.
  • Collaborate with data scientists to collect and preprocess training data, ensuring quality and representativeness.
  • Develop benchmarking tools that test models across reasoning, accuracy, and speed dimensions.
  • Implement reinforcement learning loops and self-improvement mechanisms for agent training.
  • Work with systems engineers to optimize inference speed, memory efficiency, and hardware utilization.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, or reinforcement learning.
  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
  • Understanding of training infrastructure, including distributed training, GPUs/TPUs, and data pipeline optimization.
  • Experience with end-to-end ML systems, from preprocessing and feature extraction to training, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Comfort with MLOps tools (e.g., Weights & Biases, MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, or Airflow).
  • Experience designing custom architectures or adapting LLMs, diffusion models, or transformer-based systems.

Compensation & Legal

  • Weekly Bonus of $500 - $1000 per 5 tasks created.

Application Process (Takes 20–30 mins to complete)

  • Upload resume
  • AI interview based on your resume
  • Submit form

Resources & Support

  • For details about the interview process and platform information, please check: https://talent.docs.mercor.com/welcome/welcome
  • For any help or support, reach out to: support@mercor.com

PS: Our team reviews applications daily. Please complete your AI interview and application steps to be considered for this opportunity.

descriptionHtml:
Intercom is the AI Customer Service company on a mission to help businesses provide incredible customer experiences.

Our AI agent Fin, the most advanced customer service AI agent on the market, lets businesses deliver always-on, impeccable customer service and ultimately transform their customer experiences for the better. Fin can also be combined with our Helpdesk to become a complete solution called the Intercom Customer Service Suite, which provides AI enhanced support for the more complex or high touch queries that require a human agent.

Founded in 2011 and trusted by nearly 30,000 global businesses, Intercom is setting the new standard for customer service. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and consistently deliver incredible value to our customers.

Speed is something we fight for every day at Intercom, and we believe Berlin is built for people who share that instinct. We are drawn to Berlin by its rare blend of deep technical talent and rich creative culture – all within a vibrant, globally connected city that’s close to our R&D hubs in Dublin and London. It’s a place where the best of the best technical talent thrive, and where people from around the world are eager to relocate and build ambitious products.

Our ambition is to hire 100 people in Berlin over the year ahead across engineering, AI, data science, product, and design. We believe this is the most exciting time to join, be the founding R&D talent in the region and make a lasting impact as we build the world's number one customer agent!

What's the opportunity?

Intercom’s Machine Learning team is responsible for defining new ML features, researching appropriate algorithms and technologies, and rapidly getting first prototypes in our customers’ hands.

We are an extremely product focussed team. We work in partnership with Product and Design functions of teams we support. Our team's dedicated ML product engineers enable us to move to production fast, often shipping to beta in weeks after a successful offline test.

We are very passionate about applying machine learning technology, and have productized everything from classic supervised models, to cutting-edge unsupervised clustering algorithms, to novel applications of transformer neural networks. We test and measure the real customer impact of each model we deploy.

What will I be doing?

  • Identify areas where ML can create value for our customers
  • Identify the right ML framing of product problems
  • Working with teammates and Product and Design stakeholders
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis and research
  • Deeply understand the problem area
  • Research and identify the right algorithms and tools
  • Being pragmatic, but innovating right to the cutting-edge when needed
  • Perform offline evaluation to gather evidence an algorithm will work
  • Work with engineers to bring prototypes to production
  • Plan, measure & socialize learnings to inform iteration
  • Partner deeply with the rest of team, and others, to build excellent ML products

What skills might I need?

  • Broad applied machine learning knowledge
  • 3-5 years applied ML experience
  • Practical stats knowledge (experiment design, dealing with confounding etc)
  • Intermediate programming skills
  • Strong communication skills, both within engineering teams and across disciplines.
  • Comfort with ambiguity
  • Typically have advanced education in ML or related field (e.g. MSc)
  • Scientific thinking skills

Bonus skills & attributes

  • Track record shipping ML products
  • PhD or other experience in a research environment
  • Deep experience in an applicable ML area. E.g. NLP, Deep learning, Bayesian methods, Reinforcement learning, clustering
  • Strong stats or math background
  • Visualization, data skills, SQL, matplotlib, etc.

Benefits

We are a well treated bunch, with awesome benefits! If there’s something important to you that’s not on this list, talk to us!

  • Competitive salary, annual bonus and equity
  • Regular compensation reviews - we reward great work!
  • Generous paid time off above statutory minimum
  • Generous family leave (maternity, paternity), to let you spend valuable time with your loved ones
  • Hybrid working
  • MacBooks are our standard, but we also offer Windows for certain roles when needed.
  • Fun events for Intercomrades, friends, and family!

Policies

Intercom has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Intercom. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.

Intercom values diversity and is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity. Intercom will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

title: AI Developer Technology Engineer
description: We’re currently seeking a Senior Developer Technology Engineer, Artificial Intelligence. Would you enjoy researching parallel algorithms to accelerate AI workloads on advanced computer architectures? Do you find it rewarding to identify and eliminate system bottlenecks to achieve the best possible performance on pioneering computer hardware? Could you be thrilled about an opportunity to partner with the developer community, working at the forefront of technology breakthroughs that contribute to the success of an industry leader like NVIDIA? If so, the Developer Technology Team invites you to consider this role. What You Will Be Doing In this position, you will research and develop techniques to GPU accelerate workloads in deep learning, machine learning or other AI domains. Work directly with other technical experts in their fields (industry and academia) to perform in-depth analysis and optimization of complex AI and HPC algorithms to ensure optimal AI solutions on modern CPU and GPU architectures. Publish and/or present discovered optimization techniques in developer blogs or relevant conferences to engage and educate the developer community. Influence the design of next-generation hardware architectures, software, and programming models in collaboration with research, hardware, system software, libraries, and tools teams at NVIDIA. What We Need To See An advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree (or equivalent experience). You have 8+ years of relevant experience in software development or research work. Programming fluency in C/C++ with a deep understanding of algorithms and software development. A background that includes parallel programming, e.g., CUDA, Open ACC, Open MP, MPI, pthreads, etc. Hands on experience doing low-level performance optimizations. In-depth expertise with CPU and GPU architecture fundamentals. Effective communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, good time management, and prioritization skills. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Expertise in parallelization and performance optimization of Deep Learning models arising from Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Recommender Systems, etc. Excellent understanding of linear algebra. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you a creative and autonomous computer scientist with a genuine passion for parallel computing? If so, we want to hear from you. Come, join our AI Compute Dev Tech team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field. NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.#deeplearning JR2011951

  • Effective communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, good time management, and prioritization skills.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Expertise in parallelization and performance optimization of Deep Learning models arising from Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Recommender Systems, etc.
  • Excellent understanding of linear algebra.

title: Senior Machine Learning / Big Data Engineer (m/f/d) for the Internal IT Department of a Market Leader (No consulting, 3–4 days home office per week)
description: Job Description We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer who will design, implement and operate ML solutions on the Databricks Big Data platform, support teams across the organization, and bring a strong software engineering background as well as excellent English skills. Ready to create impact? With us, you will actively shape the future of Data & AI. In this role, you will:develop and deploy ML-based services on our Databricks platformprimarily work with technologies such as Python, SQL and Linuxsupport teams from various business units in successfully building and implementing scalable Big Data and Data Science solutionsoptimize processes and standard procedures on the platform – with the goal of increasing quality and reducing costswrite performant, well-structured code – including unit tests and debugging to ensure high software qualitywork closely with experts from other IT and business functions, e.g. in the areas of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), master data, data engineering and continuous integration/continuous deliveryincorporate new trends and technologies into your project work in order to continuously enhance our solutions You should have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken, and be able to communicate in German at around A2 level. Enjoy a performance-related bonus scheme, workation options, company car option, smartphone and a modern working environment at a financially stable, crisis-proof company. Our client guarantees comprehensive onboarding and individual training opportunities. Health and fitness programs as well as a variety of employee events are also part of the familiar, medium-sized corporate culture. You can choose between several locations: Berlin, Würzburg and the Heilbronn–Schwäbisch Hall region, combined with 1-2 days of mobile/remote work per week. If you live outside the specified regions and bring substantial experience to the role, you may alternatively work on-site either one day per week or in blocks of 3–4 consecutive days per month. About the employer As the internal IT organization of a globally active industrial company, our client is driving the digitalization and automation of the group forward. descriptionHtml:
Job Description


We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer who will design, implement and operate ML solutions on the Databricks Big Data platform, support teams across the organization, and bring a strong software engineering background as well as excellent English skills.


Ready to create impact? With us, you will actively shape the future of Data & AI.


In this role, you will:

  • develop and deploy ML-based services on our Databricks platform
  • primarily work with technologies such as Python, SQL and Linux
  • support teams from various business units in successfully building and implementing scalable Big Data and Data Science solutions
  • optimize processes and standard procedures on the platform – with the goal of increasing quality and reducing costs
  • write performant, well-structured code – including unit tests and debugging to ensure high software quality
  • work closely with experts from other IT and business functions, e.g. in the areas of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), master data, data engineering and continuous integration/continuous delivery
  • incorporate new trends and technologies into your project work in order to continuously enhance our solutions


You should have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken, and be able to communicate in German at around A2 level.


Enjoy a performance-related bonus scheme, workation options, company car option, smartphone and a modern working environment at a financially stable, crisis-proof company.


Our client guarantees comprehensive onboarding and individual training opportunities. Health and fitness programs as well as a variety of employee events are also part of the familiar, medium-sized corporate culture.


You can choose between several locations: Berlin, Würzburg and the Heilbronn–Schwäbisch Hall region, combined with 1-2 days of mobile/remote work per week.


If you live outside the specified regions and bring substantial experience to the role, you may alternatively work on-site either one day per week or in blocks of 3–4 consecutive days per month.


About the employer

As the internal IT organization of a globally active industrial company, our client is driving the digitalization and automation of the group forward.


This IT division is responsible for providing and further developing IT infrastructures, data and cloud platforms, as well as digital solutions for all business units.


With its international orientation and the use of state-of-the-art technologies, the company offers experts the opportunity to design high-impact solutions and actively shape the digital transformation within a stable and economically successful corporate environment.


Education

  • A successfully completed degree in Computer Science (or a related field),
  • or a completed IT-related vocational training that provides an equivalent level of knowledge.


Skills

  • Very good skills in software development with at least one high-level programming language (e.g. Python, Java, Scala or similar)
  • Ideally, experience with Unity Catalogue, Asset Bundles, workspace creation, MLflow, Lakebase
  • Good knowledge of SQL & databases and experience with relational databases (e.g. HANA, MS SQL, MySQL)
  • Advanced knowledge of Linux / operating systems, including configuration, usage and troubleshooting
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to solve problems independently
  • You enjoy working independently and responsibly within a team structure
  • You have good communication and presentation skills and are able to convey technical concepts appropriately to different target audiences


Experience

  • At least 2 years of experience in Machine Learning Engineering on Databricks
  • Experience in building efficient and scalable Big Data and Data Science projects
  • Experience in the productive operation of ML/Data services
  • Experience in process optimization, improving standard processes and best practices
  • Experience in developing clean, maintainable and efficient code according to best practices, including unit testing and debugging
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams


Location

You can choose your primary work location between Berlin, Würzburg or the Heilbronn–Schwäbisch Hall region, combined with approximately 3–4 days of home office per week.

If you are an experienced engineer and live outside these regions, you also have the option to work on-site 3–4 consecutive days per month.


How to apply

You can expect a highly interesting and varied role at a very successful company with a long-standing tradition.

If you feel ready to take on this challenge and meet most of the required skills, we look forward to hearing from you.

If you have any questions in advance, please feel free to contact

Mr. Manfred Wenzel at +49 (0)711 4560584.

Please send your application, referring to this job advertisement, directly by e-mail to wenzel@it-personalberatung.de, ideally including:

  • A short cover letter outlining your suitability for this position
  • A concise CV, preferably with photo, clearly highlighting your experience, skills and achievements
  • References/certificates, preferably as PDF file(s)
  • Your earliest possible starting date
  • Your approximate salary expectations

I look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Simulation & Synthetic Data Generation Engineer – Self-Driving
description: VINFAST is a pioneering electric vehicle (EV) company committed to revolutionizing the automotive industry with sustainable and innovative mobility solutions. As a leading player in the EV market, Vin Fast is dedicated to delivering high-quality, cutting-edge electric vehicles that redefine the driving experience. Our team consists of passionate professionals driven by a shared vision of creating a greener and more sustainable future through innovation, technology, and excellence. Synthetic data and simulation are critical to scaling self-driving technology. In this role, you will research, develop, and deploy state-of-the-art techniques in computer graphics, computer vision, and machine learning to generate high-quality data for training and validating the self-driving stack. You will help shape the future of synthetic data generation pipelines and simulation frameworks, enabling new sensing model capabilities and accelerating development of safe autonomous vehicles. title: Machine Learning Engineer, Dash
description: Company Description Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for more enlightened ways of working. We're a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers who are shaping the future of Dropbox—and with it the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, making space for both meaningful work and meaningful relationships. With our start-up mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. Here, you can own your impact to make work more intuitive, joyful, and human—for you as a Dropboxer and for hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you're ready to push boundaries—and yourself— Dropbox is ready for you. Team Description The Dropbox Engineering Team builds the technology that creates more enlightened ways of working for hundreds of millions of people. Every day, our platforms—including Dropbox Dash, Dropbox Sign, and our core sync engine—handle over a billion files for users worldwide, creating engineering challenges as great as the opportunity for impact. Our software engineering team uses a range of technologies to solve interesting problems, including Python, React, Node.js, JavaScript, Mongo DB, PostgreSQL, and Android development. We think like a startup but build for an enterprise, exploring new possibilities that transform how people work. If you're excited about turning complex technical challenges into intuitive solutions at scale, join our Engineering team. Areas of work include Machine Learning Engineers, Infrastructure Engineer, Product SWE Frontend and Backend, Mobile Software Engineers (iOS and Android), Engineering Manager, Data Engineer, Software Development Engineer in Test, Security Engineering, Site Reliability Engineer, Technical Program Managers, Network Engineer, Datacenter Engineer, Technical Supply Chain Manager and more. Role Description As a Machine Leaning Engineer on our Multimedia AI team, you will be involved in shaping the future direction of Dropbox Dash and pushing the boundaries on what the world thinks is possible by leveraging the latest advancements in AI/ML. You will join a team of top-tier Machine Learning Engineers and be an inherent part of the product org to create and build delightful new experiences. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll leverage your ML expertise to tackle audacious challenges. Your contributions will directly impact millions of users, as every line of code you write furthers our mission to revolutionize the way people work and collaborate. Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here. Responsibilities Work with large scale data systems, and infrastructure Help productionize multimodal and semantic retrieval systems at scale, powering Dash’s multimedia and creative search experiences. Partner with product, design, and infrastructure teams to improve retrieval, ranking, and conversational experiences across image, video, and text content. Build and iterate on quick prototypes and experimental features, driving innovation in multimodal interaction and creative workflows. Run quality and performance benchmarks across individual components and end-to-end systems to identify optimization opportunities. Contribute to open source projects and leverage OSS tools for efficient inference and scaling. On-call work may be necessary occasionally to help address bugs, outages, or other operational issues, with the goal of maintaining a stable and high-quality experience for our customers. Requirements BS, MS, or Ph D in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields or related work experience5+ years of experience in engineering with 3+ years of experience building Machine Learning or AI systems Proven software engineering skills across multiple languages including but not limited to Python, Go, C/C++Experience with Machine Learning software tools and libraries (e.g., PyTorch, HuggingFace, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn, etc.) Familiarity with search-related applications of Large Language Models Proven experience in machine learning, multimodal AI, or search and ranking systems. Familiarity with semantic search, embeddings, vector retrieval, and optimizing ranking metrics such as n DCG or MRR. Experience running quality and performance benchmarks across components and end-to-end pipelines in large-scale machine learning and retrieval systems to identify and drive optimizations. Preferred Qualifications Ph D in Computer Science or related field with research in machine learning Experience with one or more of the following: natural language processing, deep learning, bayesian reasoning, recommender systems, learning to rank, speech processing, learning from semistructured data, graph learning, reinforcement or active learning, large language models, ML software systems, retrieval-augmented generationmachine learning on edge devices Experience building 0→1 ML products at large (dropbox-level) scale or multiple 0→1 products at smaller scale including experience with large-scale product systems Compensation Germany Pay Range€125.000—€169.100 EURThe range listed above is the expected annual salary/OTE (On-Target Earnings) for this role, subject to change. Please note, OTE are for sales roles only. Salary/OTE is just one component of Dropbox’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Dropbox is a Virtual First company and is open to hiring candidates in all authorized locations. Benefits Dropbox is committed to investing in the holistic health and wellbeing of all Dropboxers and their families. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage*Retirement savings through a defined contribution pension or savings plan**Flexible PTO/Paid Time Off, paid holidays, Volunteer Time Off, and more, allowing you time to unplug, unwind, and refresh Income Protection Plans: Life and disability insurance*Business Travel Protection: Travel medical and accident insurance*Perks Allowance to be used on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness, learning and development, food and groceries, and much more Parental benefits including: Parental Leave, Fertility Benefits, Adoptions and Surrogacy support, and Lactation support Mental health and wellness benefits Additional Benefits Details Are Available Upon Request. Where group plans are not available, allowances may be provided Benefit, amount, and type are dependent on geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted. See our AI philosophy. Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work. A big part of that effort is our support for members and allies of internal groups like Asians at Dropbox, Black Dropboxers, en ABLE, TODOS (Latinx), Pridebox (LGBTQ), Vets at Dropbox, and Women at Dropbox.

descriptionHtml:
The engineers who'll define the next decade aren't writing code anymore.


They design the outcome with specs/evals, delegate the execution to agents, and move faster than traditional teams ever could.

We're looking for round pegs who’ve realized the hole has changed shape entirely. You've already felt it. You're orchestrating, not typing. You're reviewing AI output, not writing it. You want to go further. So do we.


We’re looking for brilliant engineers who want to work on the cutting edge of AI AND who want their work to matter. Work that moves the needle, not making people scroll 3% more.


You might be right for this if:

  • You run multiple Claude Code instances in parallel and feel frustrated when you can't
  • You've converted at least one API into an MCP server
  • You've tried Claude Code on mobile and thought "why doesn't everyone do this"
  • You know Boris Cherny's workflow by heart
  • You've created proper evals and let AI agents cook for 30+ minutes
  • You understand that reading every line of code is a bottleneck, not a virtue
  • You have strong opinions on when to use Claude Code vs Codex
  • You thrive in uncertainty and go where it hurts


You might not be right for this if:

  • You want to write code yourself
  • Speed makes you nervous
  • You need a playbook before you start
  • You're looking for a traditional AI engineering role
  • You have not heard of Ralph Wiggum loop


What the role is about:

  • You will have the chance to shape fast-paced AI breakthrough projects for leading organizations in Europe – but in a fundamentally new way. Instead of building data pipelines and ML workflows by hand, you'll orchestrate agents to do it.
  • You'll ensure our prototypes become revolutionary, enterprise-grade AI applications, but at a pace that wasn't possible before. You'll be deploying to cloud environments, integrating with client systems, and shipping real business value – at the speed of light.
  • You will be a key contributor in growing our high-impact scale-up and shaping our identity, both internally and externally. You'll work with corporates, the Mittelstand, scale-ups, NGOs, and the public sector.
  • You'll live Agent-Driven Development every day. No playbook exists: you'll write it. This is a strategic hire - you will work closely with the Tech Leads and the COO.


What we'd love to see:

  • Knowing how to execute real-life software projects: You have at least 3 years of experience in building scalable software projects in a professional manner.
  • Leveraging AI Expertise: You have hands-on experience implementing machine learning models in production environments, including model training, deployment, and monitoring. You are proficient with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn) and understand the full ML lifecycle, from data preprocessing to model evaluation and optimization. You thrive on solving practical ML problems and are comfortable working within a team to deliver impactful solutions.
  • Bringing technical depth: You can solve diverse software engineering challenges with a flexible toolbox. You have a strong foundation in Python. Besides that, you have experience with setting up secure web applications. You bring experience with with at least one cloud platform (preferably, Microsoft Azure), too.
  • Dealing with ambiguity: Even if some challenges are vaguely defined, you make sense of what needs to be done.
  • Conversing in German: Ability to communicate in German with our clients with level B2 or higher.


What we offer:

  • Ascension - as we are going to push and enable you to do the best work of your life.
  • Anti-Mimeticism – as we are on the journey to 1000 AI breakthroughs since long before the recent hype.
  • Captivating AI breakthrough projects with a lot of room for personal development, experimentation, continuous learning, and growth.
  • A unique role in a pioneering AI company with a lot of autonomy.
  • A professional, yet flexible work environment, innovative work practices along “No rules rules,” and continuous mutual support.
  • A value-driven business with top-of-market pay.
  • All the other start-up stuff such as free drinks and snacks, game nights, ...

… and a team of warm outliers who believe the best way to predict the future is to build it 1000 times over.


Sounds like a "wow" opportunity? We can't wait to hear from you.

In Germany - Berlin | Bonn | Cologne | Frankfurt/Main | Hamburg | Munich
Help businesses make informed decisions and drive growth by transforming raw data into actionable insights. Ready to boost your personal development in data science, analytics, and AI? Become a pioneer of the digital transformation and support us as a Manager in Data Science-focused consulting.
What Makes Us Special
Advance your career with exciting professional opportunities in our thriving company with a startup feel
Add to your experience with our projects that focus on growth, have a positive impact, and truly matter
Voice your unique ideas in a corporate culture defined by our entrepreneurial spirit, openness, and integrity
Feel at home working with our helpful, enthusiastic colleagues who have great team spirit
Broaden your perspective with our extensive training curriculum and learning programs (e.g. LinkedIn Learning)
Speak your mind in our holistic feedback and development processes (e.g. 360-degree feedback)
Satisfy your need for adventure with our opportunities to live and work abroad in one of our many international offices
Enjoy our benefits, such as hybrid working, daycare allowance, corporate discounts, and wellbeing support (e.g. Headspace)
Unwind in our break areas where you can help yourself to the healthy snacks and beverages provided
See another side of your coworkers at our frequent employee events and highly anticipated World Meeting and Holiday Party
How You Will Create An Impact
You will support on extracting, loading and processing (cleaning and transforming) complex data across different industries
You will use your technical expertise to develop, test and deploy ML models based
You will develop models and analysis that adress the business question in hand and your results will align with real-world business outcomes
You will clearly communicate the scope and take ownership of your workstream and communicate back technical results to business teams and stakeholders
You will own and deliver the presentation of your analysis to your data and business counterparts at the client side and also to senior business leaders on the client side
You do bring a strong analytical mindset to uncover actionable insights
About You
A bachelor's or master's degree in business, economics, computer science, or engineering
Fluency in both German and English, with confident communication skills in both languages
At least 4 - 6 years of experience in the field of data science
A sharp analytical mindset, structured approach to problem-solving, and keen attention to detail
Effective communication skills, essential for collaboration within teams and across departments
A proactive and reliable attitude, combined with enthusiasm for teamwork
Hands-on experience with modeling using Python or similar tools
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning methods, especially tree-based methods and Bayesian methods
Familiarity with core data services (eg. Storage, compute, automation, machine learning, dashboarding) of one or more popular cloud vendors
Knowledge of relational, SQL and NoSQL databases as well as the ETL process
Knowledge & experience in one or more of the following fields would be a strong plus:
ovisualization tools such as PowerBI and Tableau
owidely used cloud tools such as AWS/GCP/Azure
oleveraging Generative AI solutions, particularly for information retrieval, trend detection, and data summarization
building front-end interfaces / steering cockpits using tools such as streamlit

Simon-Kucher is a global consultancy with more than 2,000 employees in 30+ countries.

With 40 years of experience in monetization topics of all kinds, we are regarded as the world’s leading pricing and growth specialist. simon-kucher.com
We believe in building a culture that embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion, creating an environment in which our people feel valued, are able to be themselves and feel their contribution matters. If we get that right, remarkable things will happen; people will grow faster, innovate, feel valued, and create better outcomes for everyone – our people, our clients and, of course, our business.

descriptionHtml:
Deine neue Herausforderung

Du begeisterst dich für moderne Technologien und willst mit deiner Arbeit dazu beitragen, das Gesundheitssystem digitaler und smarter zu gestalten?

Dann unterstütze unser Digital Health Team bei der Entwicklung innovativer Anwendungen an der Schnittstelle von Künstlicher Intelligenz, Gesundheit und Forschung. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir nutzerzentrierte, datenbasierte Systeme, die reale Mehrwerte für Patient:innen und Fachkräfte schaffen.

Deine Mission

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung datengetriebener Anwendungen im Bereich Digital Health
  • Mitarbeit an Data-Science-Workflows (z. B. Datenaufbereitung, Analyse, Modellierung) oder an Full-Stack-Lösungen (Frontend, Backend, Schnittstellen)
  • Integration von KI-gestützten Funktionen, z. B. Entscheidungsunterstützung, Datenanalysen oder interaktive Assistenzsysteme
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung verständlicher Daten- und Ergebnisdarstellungen für unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams aus Forschung, KI und Softwareentwicklung
  • Recherche und Bewertung neuer Technologien, Methoden und Frameworks im Kontext Digital Health

Dein Profil

  • Laufendes Studium der Informatik, Data Science, Medizininformatik, Gesundheitsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Python für Datenanalyse, Backend-Entwicklung oder Machine Learning
  • Erfahrung oder Interesse an einem der folgenden Bereiche:
    • Datenanalyse und -verarbeitung (z. B. Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn oder vergleichbar)
    • Machine Learning und KI-Methoden, z. B. Modelltraining, Evaluation oder Prompt-basierte Ansätze
    • Anwendungen von Large Language Models (LLMs) in Analyse-, Assistenz- oder Entscheidungsunterstützungssystemen
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
Warum wir?

  • Weil wir das Rundum-sorglos-Paket bieten – und 100% Enthusiasmus für die Digitale Transformation:
    • Jeden Tag das Gleiche? Nicht bei uns! Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld, in dem du dich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln kannst. Dein Gehirn bleibt in Bewegung – ganz ohne Jogginghose.
    • Innovation mit Impact: Wir arbeiten an den Technologien von morgen – und du bist mittendrin. Von GreenTech bis Smart Processes: Bei uns gibt es kein Stehenbleiben, immer nur den nächsten Schritt nach vorn.
    • Teamspirit? Check! Motivierte Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die nicht nur kluge Köpfe, sondern auch verdammt nette Menschen sind – das ist unser Team! Was zählt, ist, dass wir gemeinsam die besten Lösungen finden.
    • Ideen willkommen: Bei uns gibt’s keine "Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht"-Mentalität. Wir bieten dir den Raum und die Unterstützung, um aus deinen Visionen echte Erfolge zu machen.
    • Flexibilität? Auf jeden Fall! Bei uns bestimmst du, wann und wo du am produktivsten bist. Egal ob Flexitime oder Mobile Work – wir unterstützen deinen persönlichen Work-Style.
    • Benefits, die sich lohnen: Von Jobticket über Corporate Benefits bis hin zum Urban Sports Club - und bei uns gibt es sogar ZWEI Obstkörbe die Woche!
Deine Ansprechpersonen

Sabrina Steil

Human Resources

+49 173 7221 274

Über uns

Im August-Wilhelm Scheer Institut kommen kluge Köpfe unterschiedlicher Backgrounds zusammen, um gemeinsam digitale Innovationen und Geschäftsmodelle von morgen zu entwickeln. Unsere Vision: Wir bringen Forschung auf die Straße. Deshalb arbeiten wir an innovativen, sinnhaften und nachhaltigen Technologien und Geschäftsmodellen und das in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Anwendern. An der Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung und Praxis denken wir die digitalen Lösungen der Zukunft voraus. Und genau da ist Platz für Dich und Deine Ideen. Unser Motto: Stärken stärken. Unsere Kompetenz: Potenziale entfalten. Und dafür suchen wir Dich! Wir mögen es individuell, interdisziplinär und innovativ. Wir schaffen Raum für persönliche Wege und Lebensentwürfe und gestalten Arbeitsbedingungen, die sich an deinen Lebensphasen und Bedürfnissen orientieren. Gemeinsam bringen wir Dein Talent an die richtige Stelle.

Du willst gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft gestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!

descriptionHtml:
About Simreka

Simreka is a fast-growing deep-tech startup revolutionizing chemical and material innovation through its AI-powered simulation platform.

As a process engineer, you will play a key role in the further development of the simulation platform and delivery to customers who are manufacturing companies in a variety of domains. You will succeed in this role if you are a motivated individual driven by challenges and can bridge the gap between business requirements, mathematics, and software development to deliver results together with the whole team.


Role Overview

Simreka is seeking a Computational Scientist with a strong background in chemical and process engineering to develop, apply, and enhance physics-based and data-driven models for industrial applications. The role involves working at the intersection of process modeling, numerical methods, and advanced analytics, supporting the development of next-generation simulation and digital engineering solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and validate computational models for chemical and process engineering systems
  • Apply first-principles modeling, numerical methods, and simulation techniques to real-world industrial problems
  • Design and optimize process simulations, including steady-state and dynamic models
  • Collaborate with software developers and domain experts to integrate models into digital platforms and tools
  • Analyze experimental, plant, or simulation data to support model calibration and validation
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, and results for internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of Simreka’s modeling frameworks and computational workflows


Required Qualifications

  • Master’s, or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a closely related field
  • Strong understanding of transport phenomena, thermodynamics, reaction engineering, and process systems
  • Experience with computational modeling and simulation tools
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar)
  • Ability to translate engineering problems into mathematical and computational formulations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German


Preferred / Advantageous Skills

  • Experience in data science, machine learning, or AI techniques applied to engineering problems
  • Familiarity with model-based optimization, surrogate modeling, or hybrid physics–data models
  • Knowledge of scientific computing, numerical solvers, or high-performance computing
  • Experience working with industrial process data and life cycle assessment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multidisciplinary teams


What We Offer

  • High degree of autonomy to define and implement things your way
  • Challenging long-term personal and team objectives
  • Opportunity to have a huge business and social impact
  • An accelerated and multidimensional personal growth opportunity
  • Cross-disciplinary projects and tasks
  • A customer-centric company culture with a flat hierarchy and open communication
  • Salary and compensation in line with experience and performance

description: Über uns In den vergangenen Jahrzehnten haben wir uns mit unseren Produkten für Fahrwerk, Karosserie und Antrieb zu einem Top-Automobilzulieferer entwickelt. Mit neuen Leichtbauprodukten, Werkstoffen und Fertigungstechnologien bieten wir in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und wissenschaftlichen Institutionen innovative Lösungen für leichtere Fahrzeuge. Wir schaffen bahnbrechende Neuerungen und setzen damit internationale Standards. Als inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen mit hoher Flexibilität, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer langfristig ausgerichteten Strategie beschäftigen wir weltweit mehr als 17.500 Mitarbeiter an 58 Standorten in über 20 Ländern. Das Sind Deine Aufgaben Gestalte die digitale Zukunft der Produktion aktiv mit! In unserem Zentralbereich Fertigungstechnologien unterstützt Du uns beim Aufbau intelligenter Produktionssysteme. Du arbeitest an Machine Learning Use Cases wie Predictive Maintenance, Anomalieerkennung und Prozessoptimierung – von der Datenanalyse bis zum produktiven ML-Modell. Dabei nutzt Du Echtzeitdaten aus unserer zentralen Io T-Plattform, entwickelst Auswertungsalgorithmen und baust Dashboards für unsere weltweiten Produktionsstandorte auf. Du bekommst Einblicke in modernste Fertigungstechnologien und arbeitest in cross-funktionalen Projekten mit Produktionsexperten zusammen. Deine Analysen haben direkten Impact auf die Effizienz unserer Werke. Das Wünschen Wir Uns Von Dir Du befindest Dich mindestens im 3. Semester Deines B. Sc.- oder stehst am Anfang deines M. Sc.-Studiums in Data Science, Informatik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Mathematik oder einem verwandten Studiengang. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen mit Python und interessierst Dich für Machine Learning (z. B. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, pandas). Du gehst sicher mit Datenanalyse und Visualisierung um. Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig in Attendorn zu arbeiten. Du bringst analytisches Denken, Neugier und eine Hands-on-Mentalität mit. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit SQL, Zeitreihendaten oder Io T-Systemen gearbeitet. Unser Angebot Worauf Du Dich Bei Mubea Freuen Kannst Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

In den vergangenen Jahrzehnten haben wir uns mit unseren Produkten für Fahrwerk, Karosserie und Antrieb zu einem Top-Automobilzulieferer entwickelt. Mit neuen Leichtbauprodukten, Werkstoffen und Fertigungstechnologien bieten wir in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und wissenschaftlichen Institutionen innovative Lösungen für leichtere Fahrzeuge. Wir schaffen bahnbrechende Neuerungen und setzen damit internationale Standards.

Als inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen mit hoher Flexibilität, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer langfristig ausgerichteten Strategie beschäftigen wir weltweit mehr als 17.500 Mitarbeiter an 58 Standorten in über 20 Ländern.

Das Sind Deine Aufgaben

Gestalte die digitale Zukunft der Produktion aktiv mit! In unserem Zentralbereich Fertigungstechnologien unterstützt Du uns beim Aufbau intelligenter Produktionssysteme. Du arbeitest an Machine Learning Use Cases wie Predictive Maintenance, Anomalieerkennung und Prozessoptimierung – von der Datenanalyse bis zum produktiven ML-Modell. Dabei nutzt Du Echtzeitdaten aus unserer zentralen IoT-Plattform, entwickelst Auswertungsalgorithmen und baust Dashboards für unsere weltweiten Produktionsstandorte auf. Du bekommst Einblicke in modernste Fertigungstechnologien und arbeitest in cross-funktionalen Projekten mit Produktionsexperten zusammen. Deine Analysen haben direkten Impact auf die Effizienz unserer Werke.

Das Wünschen Wir Uns Von Dir

  • Du befindest Dich mindestens im 3. Semester Deines B.Sc.- oder stehst am Anfang deines M.Sc.-Studiums in Data Science, Informatik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Mathematik oder einem verwandten Studiengang.
  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen mit Python und interessierst Dich für Machine Learning (z.B. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, pandas).
  • Du gehst sicher mit Datenanalyse und Visualisierung um.
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig in Attendorn zu arbeiten.
  • Du bringst analytisches Denken, Neugier und eine Hands-on-Mentalität mit.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

descriptionHtml:
Wir verändern die Versicherungswelt – und suchen dich, um die Zukunft mitzugestalten. Als einer der größten deutschen Versicherer und Finanzdienstleister mit Hauptsitz in Hamburg und Dortmund haben wir uns in den letzten Jahren grundlegend transformiert. Unsere moderne und agile Arbeitswelt, in der wir nutzenzentriert arbeiten, ist von Offenheit und Mut geprägt. Dabei legen wir viel Wert auf gegenseitige Wertschätzung und Vertrauen. Wir heißen Vielfalt in all ihren Facetten willkommen und glauben, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Erfahrungen entscheidend für Innovation sind. Werde Teil unseres Teams, bring deine Ideen ein und verändere mit uns das Jetzt.

Aufgaben

Im Center of Excellence Künstliche Intelligenz übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Umsetzung unserer KI-Strategie. Als Werkstudent arbeitest Du eng mit Fachbereichen, IT und Data Experts zusammen. Du unterstützt die Governance konforme Entwicklung und Skalierung von KI-Anwendungen und trägst dazu bei, dass SIGNAL IDUNA KI verantwortungsvoll und wirkungsvoll einsetzt.

Dein Aufgabengebiet

  • Du unterstützt das CoE KI im Tagesgeschäft, bei der Organisation von Workshops sowie organisatorischen Tätigkeiten
  • Du hilfst bei der Vorbereitung von Präsentationen, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Schulungsunterlagen, um komplexe KI-Themen für verschiedene Zielgruppen verständlich aufzubereiten
  • Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich organisatorische Aufgaben rund um KI-Governance und Change & Adoption
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren KI-Expert:innen zusammen und unterstützt sie tatkräftig in ihren Aufgaben
  • Du bist Teil der Operationalisierung einer KI-Governance
  • Du förderst den Wissenstransfer und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Business, IT und Data Science

Profil

  • befindest dich im fortgeschrittenen Studium in einem relevanten Studiengang, z.B. (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit Tech-Fokus oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • hast fundierte Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI und KI-Agenten sowohl in der Nutzung als auch Implementierung
  • verfügst über fundiertes Wissen zu Machine Learning und AI Technologie
  • kannst komplexe Themen klar und verständlich aufbereiten und verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • hast idealerweise Kenntnisse in KI-Governance, Modellbewertung und regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. EU AI Act)
  • bist sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere PowerPoint
  • bist ein Teamplayer, kommunizierst klar und bringst deine Ideen proaktiv ein

Wir bieten

  • kannst du jeden Tag Veränderungen mitgestalten #veränderedasjetzt
  • kannst du mobil arbeiten und durch ein flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell dein Studienleben und deine Arbeit gut kombinieren
  • bekommst du ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und einem motivierten Team, das dich unterstützt
  • entstehen Perspektiven für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung
  • kannst du dich auf regionales und abwechslungsreiches Essen in unseren Betriebsrestaurants freuen – auch mit veganen Alternativen
  • gehörst du von Anfang an dazu und übernimmst Verantwortung

Important note

Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered.

title: Founder's Associate Intern (m/f/d)
description: What We Do Merantix Momentum, part of the Merantix Group, is a Berlin-based AI startup focusing on accelerating AI adoption across many industries through B2B solutions as well as Publicly Funded Research Projects. We work across several domains including manufacturing, public sector, healthcare and many more, and transform businesses as an external machine learning department using our core expertise in state-of-the-art machine learning combined with our culture of rapid iterations to build scalable solutions. Your role The central mission of this role is to support the leadership team, helping them as a dynamic problem solver across a wide breadth of activities and strategic projects. You will report directly to the CFO while also working closely with the CEO and CTO. If the prospect of wearing many hats in a dynamic environment excites you and you want to play an instrumental role in helping us build and scale efficient ML solutions, you are in the right place! These will be your main responsibilities:Assist with engagements, public appearances and thought leadership; research, ideate and develop content for presentations (Google Slides, pitch.com, etc), articles, and additional formats Contribute to strategic projects; conduct initial research, diligence and analysis on exploratory topics and advancing strategic initiatives across the organization Take ownership of process optimisation: evaluate and introduce new tools, automate workflows, and set up simple, scalable processes. Act as a versatile problem solver for the leadership team, filling gaps where extra bandwidth is needed. Your profile We know that many amazing candidates’ CVs might not, on paper, line up perfectly with the job description as written. If you do not meet every criteria but still believe you would be a good fit for the role, we strongly encourage you to apply! The ideal candidate is autonomous, versatile, excited to learn, and feels at home taking ownership in high-demand, fast-paced environments. A fast learner who enjoys figuring out new tools, testing them, and creating automations. They will bring excellent problem solving skills in order to quickly understand context, anticipate needs, manage complexity, and deliver reliably. Our hierarchy is flat and communication direct, which means that we operate and learn fast, as a team. YOU are a great fit for our team if you :Are Independent and autonomous, able to take ownership Ok speaking up and sharing candid, transparent points of view Action-oriented, with a preference for moving ideas forward rather than over-deliberating. Excited by the idea of working on both strategic topics and hands-on operations. A fast learner who enjoys figuring out process optimisation, tooling and data analytics. Motivated by growth and supporting your team with a “no task too small” mindset. Must haves Strong organizational and problem solving skill set The ability to prioritize and juggle many moving parts Strong research and communication skills with a knack for crafting narratives and designing presentations quickly and with style Demonstrated interests in tools, workflows and process improvement. Business fluent English Eligible to intern in Germany Nice to haves First experience in business operations, strategy, startups, AI, and/or other relevant fields Familiarity with German (enough to proof-read content)A knack for automating and streamlining processes and workflows Basic experience with data tools (Looker, Google Sheets/Excel, SQL), process automation solutions, and AI assistants (Chat GPT, Perplexity,...)What We Offer This is a paid internship offering a salary in line the market. Beyond the salary, this position promises to deliver a highly valuable learning experience where your curiosity is encouraged. We know that every company advertises their amazing culture and learning opportunities, but at Merantix Momentum you can count on the support of a truly wonderful team of colleagues who are all genuinely invested in your success. Benefits include:Hands-on learning and development, including deep exposure to the cutting edge of AI innovation The support of a fantastic team of collaborative, talented individuals with diverse skill sets and backgrounds The possibility to grow into other roles in the organization/Merantix ecosystem Ample opportunities to engage with the Merantix ecosystem A vibrant, dynamic working environment at the AI Campus A generous education and equipment budget We offer a monthly allowance per employee that can be allocated as desired to one of the following: Mobility & transportation (RYDES), sports (Urban Sports Club) or groceries (Edenred)Flexible hybrid work and vacation policy About Us We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity. We consider all applications equally regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underrepresented in tech to apply, and we can help with immigration.

Merantix Momentum, part of the Merantix Group, is a Berlin-based AI startup focusing on accelerating AI adoption across many industries through B2B solutions as well as Publicly Funded Research Projects. We work across several domains including manufacturing, public sector, healthcare and many more, and transform businesses as an external machine learning department using our core expertise in state-of-the-art machine learning combined with our culture of rapid iterations to build scalable solutions.

Your role

You will report directly to the CFO while also working closely with the CEO and CTO. If the prospect of wearing many hats in a dynamic environment excites you and you want to play an instrumental role in helping us build and scale efficient ML solutions, you are in the right place!

  • Assist with engagements, public appearances and thought leadership; research, ideate and develop content for presentations (Google Slides, pitch.com, etc), articles, and additional formats
  • Contribute to strategic projects; conduct initial research, diligence and analysis on exploratory topics and advancing strategic initiatives across the organization
  • Take ownership of process optimisation: evaluate and introduce new tools, automate workflows, and set up simple, scalable processes.
  • Act as a versatile problem solver for the leadership team, filling gaps where extra bandwidth is needed.

Your profile

  • We know that many amazing candidates’ CVs might not, on paper, line up perfectly with the job description as written. If you do not meet every criteria but still believe you would be a good fit for the role, we strongly encourage you to apply!

The ideal candidate is autonomous, versatile, excited to learn, and feels at home taking ownership in high-demand, fast-paced environments.

A fast learner who enjoys figuring out new tools, testing them, and creating automations. They will bring excellent problem solving skills in order to quickly understand context, anticipate needs, manage complexity, and deliver reliably. Our hierarchy is flat and communication direct, which means that we operate and learn fast, as a team.

YOU are a great fit for our team if you :

Are

  • Independent and autonomous, able to take ownership
  • Ok speaking up and sharing candid, transparent points of view
  • Action-oriented, with a preference for moving ideas forward rather than over-deliberating.
  • Excited by the idea of working on both strategic topics and hands-on operations.
  • A fast learner who enjoys figuring out process optimisation, tooling and data analytics.
  • Motivated by growth and supporting your team with a “no task too small” mindset.

Must haves

  • Strong organizational and problem solving skill set
  • The ability to prioritize and juggle many moving parts
  • Strong research and communication skills with a knack for crafting narratives and designing presentations quickly and with style
  • Demonstrated interests in tools, workflows and process improvement.
  • Business fluent English
  • Eligible to intern in Germany

descriptionHtml:
Die Süddeutsche Zeitung Digitale Medien GmbH (SZDM) ist das digitale Kreativzentrum der Süddeutschen Zeitung. Einfach schneller mehr wissen: Die technische, gestalterische und redaktionelle Produktion aller digitalen Produkte der Süddeutschen Zeitung ist die Hauptaufgabe der SZDM. Wir entdecken die Welt minütlich neu und überraschen täglich mit vielseitigen Inhalten. Wir berichten so schnell wie das Netz und so verlässlich wie eine renommierte Zeitung.


Zusätzlich zur Website betreuen wir alle mobilen Angebote und Apps des Hauses, das umfangreiche digitale Pay-Angebot sowie die Zeitungsapp, die täglich eine digitale Version der Zeitung bietet. Mit Podcasts, Newslettern und Chatbots landen die wichtigsten Themen in Echtzeit auf dem eigenen Device.


Zur Verstärkung unserer Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Developer (m/w/d) für AI und MLOps mit der Mission Generative KI und generell Machine Learning nutzbar zu machen – von Prototypen über robuste Services bis zum skalierbaren Betrieb.


Worin du dich verwirklichen kannst


  • Entwicklung und Betrieb moderner KI- und ML-Systeme: von GenAI und RAG über Recommender Systeme bis hin zu einfachen Prediction Modellen
  • Verantwortung für Skalierbarkeit, Qualität und Compliance über den gesamten Lebenszyklus – egal ob SZDM-eigene, integrierte oder API-basierte Modelle.
  • Aufbau von Observability, Monitoring und Evaluierungs-Frameworks für messbare Modell-Performance.
  • Gestaltung, Weiterentwicklung und Durchsetzung technischer Leitplanken, Best Practices und Tooling für AI & MLOps.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement sowie Data & AI Teams um KI-Initiativen strategisch und operativ voranzutreiben.


Was wir uns von dir wünschen


  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktionsreifer KI-Systeme mit nachweislichem Business Impact
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Python sowie verschiedenen Frameworks für ML und AI (z.B. MLflow, scikit-learn, HF/transformers)
  • Fundiertes Know-how in MLOps & Data: Datenqualität, Reproduzierbarkeit, online/offline Evaluierung, Observability, CI/CD
  • Routine im Umgang mit Cloud Infrastruktur, sowohl KI-spezifisch als auch generell, insbesondere in AWS, u.a. EKS, Lambda, OpenSearch, DynamoDB, MQ, Bedrock
  • Freude an Standards, Struktur und Qualität
  • Fähigkeit komplexe, v.a. technische, Themen verständlich zu machen – von Entwicklern, über Produktmanager bis hin zu C-Level


Was wir Dir bieten


  • Starte mit einem strukturierten Onboarding: Lerne unser Medienhaus sowie unseren CEO kennen und vernetze dich mit neuen und erfahrenen Kolleg:innen
  • Erhalte das volle Paket: Arbeite hybrid und genieße 30 Urlaubstage sowie attraktive Rabatte und vergünstigte Abos für Mitarbeitende
  • Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel: Arbeite remote und in unserem digitalen, regionalen Medienhaus mit kurzen Wegen zum Betriebsrestaurant, der Cafeteria sowie kostenfreien Parkmöglichkeiten
  • Gestalte deinen Entwicklungsweg individuell: Die hausinterne SWMH-Akademie hat einiges im Angebot von Trainings über Coaching bis hin zu mehrmonatigen Entwicklungsprogrammen
  • Bleibe geistig und körperlich fit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen. Deshalb bieten wir Dir eine ganzheitliche Gesundheitsförderung an, welche unter anderem Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie verschiedene Impulse zum Thema Gesundheit beinhalten
  • Vereine Berufs- und Privatleben: Wir haben eine betriebseigene Kindertagesstätte im Haus
  • Bringe Dich ein: Wir geben Themen rund um Diversity und Inklusion Raum und bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden Fokus- und Netzwerkgruppen an, um sich einzubringen
  • Hilf mit: Wir nutzen unsere Reichweite für den guten Zweck und unterstützen regionale Hilfsorganisationen. Mehr Infos dazu hier
  • Arbeite frei in einem stabilen Umfeld: Agile und dezentrale Firmen und Einheiten, eingebettet in die Stabilität einer Holding


Und über allem steht:

Bei der SWMH leben wir Vielfalt! Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit und ein wertschätzendes und vorurteilsfreies Arbeitsumfeld ein. Daher sind wir auch Unterzeichner der „Charta der Vielfalt“.


Überzeugt?


Mehr zum Bewerbungsprozess hier. Jetzt online in nur 5 Minuten bewerben! Wir freuen uns über aussagekräftige Bewerbungen inklusive CV, Anschreiben und Zeugnissen.


Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen, auch wenn nicht alle Kriterien erfüllt werden können, verzichten jedoch auf reine Initiativbewerbungen.


Kontakt:

SZ Digitale Medien GmbH

Hultschiner Straße 8

81677 München

description: Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten. Du willst im Bereich Consulting Delivery – Artificial Intelligence and Data Kunden helfen, strategische Entscheidungen zu AI & Data umzusetzen? Unser Team unterstützt Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung und Implementierung innovativer KI-Lösungen – von Conversational AI für Chat- und Voice-Kanäle bis hin zu Machine Learning und Generative AI für datengetriebene Entscheidungsprozesse. Wir kombinieren Cloud-Technologien, skalierbare Architekturen und modernste Methoden, um die Interaktion und Datenverarbeitung unserer Kunden zu revolutionieren. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Conversational AI & Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d). Standorte: Leipzig und Görlitz. Dein Impact:Als Conversational AI & Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung von KI-Lösungen – von Conversational AI bis hin zu ML/Gen AI-Architekturen. Architektur & Design: Entwickle Strategien für skalierbare Plattformen und entwirf die zugrunde liegende Architektur für Conversational AI- und Gen AI-Systeme. Technische Umsetzung: Implementiere und optimiere KI-Plattformen, entwickle NLU-Modelle und ML-Pipelines, integriere Cloud-Lösungen (Azure/GCP/AWS) und MLOps/DevOps-Prozesse. Innovation: Berate Kunden zu zukunftsorientierten KI-Lösungen und unterstütze sie bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung datengetriebener Kommunikations- und Entscheidungsmodelle. Prototyping & Testing: Begleite Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Nutzung und optimiere Modelle und Schnittstellen. Best Practices: Trage aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung von Best Practices und unseres Service-Portfolios bei. Dein Skillset:Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Informatikbezug oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang Kenntnisse in Python und SQL sowie erste praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Einführung von ML- und Gen AI-Lösungen Erfahrung mit relevanten Frameworks (z. B. LangChain, TensorFlow, PyTorch) sind von Vorteil Idealerweise Grundkenntnisse und Erfahrung in Cloud- und Datenplattformen (z. B. Azure, AWS, GCP) sowie in MLOps-, CI/CD- und Container-Ökosystemen (Docker, Kubernetes)Ausgezeichnete Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch (C1) und Englisch, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich. Deine Chance:Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits Work-Life-Balance durch Mobile Working & Teilzeit, EU Remote Working, Sabbaticals, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Well-being Angebote wie z. B. Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und den Familienservice, der dich bei privaten Herausforderungen unterstützt Exzellente Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University, in On- und Offline-Seminaren und im Rahmen der Berufsqualifikation Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied! Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. descriptionHtml:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Consulting Delivery – Artificial Intelligence and Data Kunden helfen, strategische Entscheidungen zu AI & Data umzusetzen? Unser Team unterstützt Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung und Implementierung innovativer KI-Lösungen – von Conversational AI für Chat- und Voice-Kanäle bis hin zu Machine Learning und Generative AI für datengetriebene Entscheidungsprozesse. Wir kombinieren Cloud-Technologien, skalierbare Architekturen und modernste Methoden, um die Interaktion und Datenverarbeitung unserer Kunden zu revolutionieren. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Conversational AI & Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d).

Standorte: Leipzig und Görlitz.

Dein Impact:

Als Conversational AI & Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung von KI-Lösungen – von Conversational AI bis hin zu ML/GenAI-Architekturen.

  • Architektur & Design: Entwickle Strategien für skalierbare Plattformen und entwirf die zugrunde liegende Architektur für Conversational AI- und GenAI-Systeme.
  • Technische Umsetzung: Implementiere und optimiere KI-Plattformen, entwickle NLU-Modelle und ML-Pipelines, integriere Cloud-Lösungen (Azure/GCP/AWS) und MLOps/DevOps-Prozesse.
  • Innovation: Berate Kunden zu zukunftsorientierten KI-Lösungen und unterstütze sie bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung datengetriebener Kommunikations- und Entscheidungsmodelle.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Begleite Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Nutzung und optimiere Modelle und Schnittstellen.
  • Best Practices: Trage aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung von Best Practices und unseres Service-Portfolios bei.

Dein Skillset:

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Informatikbezug oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Kenntnisse in Python und SQL sowie erste praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Einführung von ML- und GenAI-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung mit relevanten Frameworks (z. B. LangChain, TensorFlow, PyTorch) sind von Vorteil
  • Idealerweise Grundkenntnisse und Erfahrung in Cloud- und Datenplattformen (z. B. Azure, AWS, GCP) sowie in MLOps-, CI/CD- und Container-Ökosystemen (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Ausgezeichnete Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch (C1) und Englisch, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.

Deine Chance:

  • Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen
  • Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits
  • Work-Life-Balance durch Mobile Working & Teilzeit, EU Remote Working, Sabbaticals, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Well-being Angebote wie z. B. Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und den Familienservice, der dich bei privaten Herausforderungen unterstützt
  • Exzellente Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University, in On- und Offline-Seminaren und im Rahmen der Berufsqualifikation
  • Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied!

Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.

Gleiche Chancen für alle: Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die so vielfältig sind wie wir – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft und Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Noch Fragen? Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren Bewerbungs-FAQs.

Dein Kontakt bei Fragen rund um Karrierethemen

Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111.
