descriptionHtml:
Summary

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming great products very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

The Music Creation Apps team is seeking a music data specialist to bring deep musical expertise to our ML development workflows. Working closely with content, data and machine learning engineers, you'll evaluate music datasets from a musicological perspective, ensuring data quality through your understanding of music theory, composition, and instrumentation.

You'll use Python and specialized music libraries to analyze musical characteristics, identify gaps in dataset representation, and validate the musical accuracy of our training data. This unique role combines your passion for music with technical skills to maintain Apple's high standards for musical authenticity and creative excellence in our AI-powered music creation tools.

Description

As a Music Data Specialist for Music Creation Apps, you'll apply your music theory and production knowledge to evaluate and curate datasets to train machine learning models. You'll provide the musical expertise needed to assess dataset quality, identify musical biases or gaps, and validate that our training data represents diverse musical styles and genres authentically.

Using Python and music analysis libraries like librosa, you'll analyze and evaluate musical characteristics to ensure our datasets meet the high standards required for professional music creation applications. You'll also contribute to building evaluation frameworks that assess model outputs from a musical perspective, helping bridge the gap between technical ML metrics and real-world musical quality.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze and evaluate music datasets for musical characteristics and high quality across genres.
  • Analyze musical characteristics of large-scale datasets using Python.
  • Create and curate music datasets through recording sessions, synthetic data generation, and musical content creation.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to develop data curation strategies that ensure musical authenticity and diversity.
  • Validate model outputs and training results for musical correctness, coherence, and creative quality.
  • Document musical characteristics, metadata requirements, and quality standards for music datasets.
  • Design evaluation criteria and test cases that assess ML models from a musical perspective.
  • Work with ML researchers and engineers to communicate musical requirements and provide domain expertise.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Audio Production, Musicology, Music Technology, or related field, or 3 years of equivalent professional work experience
  • Experience with Python programming and data analysis using pandas or similar libraries
  • Understanding of machine learning concepts and audio signal processing fundamentals
  • Advanced knowledge of music theory, harmony, composition, and instrumentation across multiple genres

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with music analysis libraries such as librosa or music21
  • Experience analyzing large music datasets or music information retrieval research
  • Experience curating large-scale, multi-language music datasets for LLM fine-tuning and model adaptation workflows
  • Expert in music creation tools such Logic Pro
  • Experience working on music research or data-driven music projects
  • Experience with data visualization for music analysis or dataset exploration
  • Knowledge of ML model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality
  • Fluent in English

At Apple, we’re not all the same. And that’s our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we’ve experienced, and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally. We will work with applicants to make any reasonable accommodations.

descriptionHtml:
The AI Research Division of Agile Robots are looking for ML researchers and engineers with strong experience in robotics-adjacent domains such as (simulation research, generative modelling, or multimodal ML) and who can build machine-learning systems end-to-end, not just train models. You don’t need a robotics background, but you do need solid engineering instincts, clean Python, and the ability to work with complex, noisy, real-world data.


This posting serves as a broader entry point to several AI & Robotics teams. After we evaluate your background, we’ll match you with the specific role and team where your skills have the most impact. The team assignment happens during the interview process.


Your Responsibilities

(Your exact scope depends on your background and team alignment.)


  • Model development: Build ML components across perception, prediction, or policy pathways (e.g., video models, multimodal encoders, world models, diffusion/transformer architectures).
  • Systems integration: Work with real datasets, real-time constraints, and ML pipelines that must operate reliably on embodied robotic platforms.
  • Multimodal data: Work with inputs such as video, teleoperation actions, proprioception, tactile signals, or simulation-generated sequences.
  • Evaluation & iteration: Test models in realistic environments, analyze failure modes, and refine for stability, drift, latency, and robustness.
  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration: Partner with teams focusing on modelling, robotics, teleoperation, simulation, and data systems; depending on the final role you land in.


Essential Skills

  • Deep ML experience in video modelling, generative models, sequence modelling, world models, RL, or simulation-based learning.
  • Strong software engineering ability: writing clean, modular Python and building ML systems end-to-end; including implementing architectures, training loops, and data pipelines from scratch.
  • Real-world ML mindset: experience with noisy, multimodal, temporal, or large-scale datasets (not just clean academic examples).
  • Engineering maturity: ability to debug, profile, optimize, and scale ML systems beyond prototype level.
  • PyTorch expertise: hands-on experience with training pipelines, distributed workloads, or deployment workflows.


Beneficial Skills

  • Multimodal intuition: combining signals such as vision, pose, audio, force/tactile, or simulation state.
  • Systems sense: familiarity with streaming architectures, real-time constraints, microservices, or serialization formats (e.g., Protobuf / MCAP).
  • Embodied-AI curiosity: interest in teleoperation interfaces, robot interaction, or real-world control dynamics.
  • Simulation experience: knowledge of Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Unity, Unreal, or related simulation platforms.


What we offer

  • Dynamic high-tech company combined with financial soundness and world class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities in the context of our continued growth.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program that covers health, mobility and learning with 100 € net per month.
  • Modern office facilites with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment.



Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 2300 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.


This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

description: About the Company: For one of our clients in the sports clothing industry, we are looking for a freelance AI Archive Senior 3D ML Engineer (all genders). About the project: 3D Generative AI Toolchain Development. The AI Archive project is an initiative within the client organization to research, prototype, and develop internal capabilities for 3D product design and development using generative AI. The project focuses on identifying, adapting, and fine-tuning state-of-the-art 3D generative models to support specific use cases. The toolchain leverages modern machine learning architectures and in-house datasets to enable AI-assisted product design and engineering/creation. description: Research Associate (m/f/d) -Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiterin Institute for Medical Technology and Intelligent Systems Remuneration EG 13TV-LID: 3126WE1Start of employment: 01.04.2026Application deadline 09.02.2026Scope full time and fixed-Term until three years Our institute has a long standing track record developing AI methods for medicine. We are particularly interested in machine learning, medical robotics and navigation, image guidedance, and treatment planning. In a project with clinical partners we are developing an AI based system for guiding robotic surgery. The focus will be on deep learning methods for image processing and tumor localization using robotic instruments. We will develop a prototypical software for 3D visualization of the surgical scene. YOUR TASKSDeveloping and evaluating deep learning methods for image processing, particularly to identify tissue and instrument motion Implementing interfaces to a robot and a 3D visualization environment, navigating the surgeons to the target Collaborating with different partners, including a clinic, supporting the pre-clinical evaluation of the system Systematic experimental evaluations, including on realistic data Presentation of your results at top-tier international conferences and publication in high-ranking journals YOUR PROFILERequirements Completed scientific university studies, in particular in the subject Computer Science or related fields Desired knowledge and personal skills Very good programming skills, particularly in Python and C++Excellent knowledge of recent machine learning methods and frameworks Very good understanding of medical imaging and image processing as well as robotics, experience with AR/VR is a plus Excellent English language and scientific writing skills are required (at least C1), German is a plus OUR OFFEROutside of duties, further scientific training is possible, the results can be used for a dissertation Interdisciplinary team and collaborate with academic and clinical partners Work on state of the art AI methods with a meaningful purpose Room to grow and to implement your ideas At the heart of TU Hamburg’s research, teaching and transfer of technology is the guiding principle of developing technology for people. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodation, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting edge technology that connects travelers with more than 2.5 million accommodations globally. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 4,000+ talents coming from 90+ different nationalities foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enabling our customers to experience the world. Get to Know Our Team The Engineering department oversees all Agoda’s ML and software related requirements. Our goal is to enable and increase Agoda’s business through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, ML driven solutions, queue systems and data monitoring tools. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the engineering team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the ML engineering squad, but also the reward. Work with experienced engineers and product owners to identify and build tools to automate many large-scale data management / analysis tasks. We believe in end-to-end ownership; this role will involve taking ML models to production at a scale. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodation, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting edge technology that connects travelers with more than 2.5 million accommodations globally. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 4,000+ talents coming from 90+ different nationalities foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enabling our customers to experience the world.

Get to Know Our Team

The Engineering department oversees all Agoda’s ML and software related requirements. Our goal is to enable and increase Agoda’s business through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, ML driven solutions, queue systems and data monitoring tools. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the engineering team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the ML engineering squad, but also the reward. We work across structured and non-structured data at scale. For example, our current ML models process millions of images every day to try and enhance the experience that our users get from our app.

Why Agoda Engineering Team (ML role)?

Our engineering teams are at the intersection of business analytics, ml engineering, data warehousing and software engineering. Our job involves dealing with distributed systems, stream processing, ml modeling and computation at tens of PB Scale. We focus on software engineering related to data replication, storage, centralized computation, and Data API’s. By providing our users with ML products/tools, shared frameworks, and ML services, we enable our company to validate strategic decisions, make smarter choices, and react to the fast-changing world. We are a small but passionate team with people from different nationalities working together on a single goal.

This role is based in Gurgaon, India.

In this Role, you will get to:

  • Lead the team technically in improving scalability, stability, accuracy, speed and efficiency of our existing ML systems and processes.
  • Build, administer and scale ML processing pipelines.
  • Be comfortable navigating the following technology stack: Python3, Pyspark, scripting (Bash/Python), Hadoop, SQL, S3 etc.
  • Should be able to understand internals of ML models such as Random Forest, CNN, Regression models, etc
  • Design, build, test and deploy new libraries, frameworks or full systems for our core systems while keeping to the highest standards of testing and code quality.
  • Work with experienced engineers and product owners to identify and build tools to automate many large-scale data management / analysis tasks.
  • We believe in end-to-end ownership; this role will involve taking ML models to production at a scale.

What You’ll need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science /information systems/engineering/related field
  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering with a minimum of 4+ years in ML
  • Good experience in Pyspark
  • Expert level understanding of Python with design patterns and object-oriented programming.
  • Experience debugging and reasoning about production issues is desirable.
  • A good understanding of data architecture principles preferred.
  • Any other experience with Big Data technologies / tools
  • SQL experience
  • Analytical problem-solving capabilities & experience.
  • Systems administration skills in Linux
  • A strong engineering driven mindset will be required to succeed in this role.

It’s great if you have:

  • Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystems
  • Experience working with Open-source products
  • Experience with Scala development
  • Working in an agile environment using test driven methodologies

Benefits

  • Hybrid Working Model
  • WFH Set Up Allowance
  • 30 Days of Remote Working from anywhere globally every year
  • Employee discount for accommodation globally
  • Global team of 90+ nationalities
  • 40+ offices and 25+ countries
  • Annual CSR / Volunteer Time off
  • Benevity Subscription for employee donations
  • Volunteering opportunities globally
  • Free Headspace subscription
  • Free Odilo & Udemy subscriptions
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program (third party for personal and workplace support)
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Life, TPD & Accident Insurance

descriptionHtml:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM


Have you ever been deterred from buying the product you like on Zalando because of incomplete product information? Have you ever received products that don't look similar to the image on the website, that you have to return and ask for a refund? At Zalando, we strive to ensure a smooth customer experience and prevent such things from happening. If you want to help Zalando build the next-Gen solution to monitor assortment performance, and identify poorly performed products (e.g. high returns) or bad actors, come join us!

INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

At Zalando, our vision is to be inclusive by design. And this vision starts with our

hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. You are welcome to leave out your picture, age, or marital status from your application. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit.

We want to provide you with a great candidate experience. Feel free to inform us of any accommodations you may need, so we can best support you throughout the hiring process.

do.BETTER - our diversity & inclusion strategy

https //corporate.zalando.com/en/our-impact/dobetter-our-diversity-and-inclusion- strategy


WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)



  • Actively contribute to the team roadmap, and work closely with product managers and engineers to identify areas of opportunity and resource requirements to deliver impactful projects
  • Conceptualize, prototype, and productionize state-of-the-art anomaly detection systems. You enjoy finding root causes and solutions to new complex problems and don’t mind getting your hands dirty (with pen and paper or in your IDE of choice).
  • Communicate technical problems and results effectively with other team members and also with (less technical) stakeholders. Educate them about your products and solutions.
  • Be the owner of the whole development cycle of algorithms - from opportunity discovery to production. Iteratively improve models and explore the art of possibility (e.g. new data sources, new ways of structuring the problem)
  • Build model pipelines and streamline analysis processes, using common programming tools (e.g. Python, R, Scala, SQL, PyTorch, Tensorflow etc.)



WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF



  • Master degree or above (PhD) in data science, statistics, mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative discipline with a strong theoretical foundation in machine learning methodologies. Command of causal inference and econometrics is a big plus.
  • At least 3 years of industry experience (1 years with PhD degree) in developing anomaly detection and risk scoring, using both statistical methods and machine learning techniques.
  • Extensive experience with Python and its associated data science libraries, including writing production quality code (not just notebooks). Proficiency with Databricks/Spark is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a curious and self-starter mindset. Ability to unblock yourself, but also proactively request support when needed to remove roadblocks



OUR OFFER


Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


  • Employee shares program
  • 40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
  • 2 paid volunteering days a year
  • Hybrid working model with up to 60% remote per week, actual practice is up to each team to best support their collaboration
  • Work from abroad for up to 30 working days a year
  • 27 days of vacation a year to start for full-time employees
  • Relocation assistance available (subject to prior agreement)
  • Family services, including counseling and support
  • Health and wellbeing options (including Wellhub, formerly Gympass)
  • Mental health support and coaching available
  • Drive your development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review

Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodation, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting edge technology that connects travelers with more than 2.5 million accommodations globally. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 4,000+ talents coming from 90+ different nationalities foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enabling our customers to experience the world. Get to Know Our Team The Engineering department oversees all Agoda’s ML and software related requirements. Our goal is to enable and increase Agoda’s business through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, ML driven solutions, queue systems and data monitoring tools. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the engineering team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the ML engineering squad, but also the reward. Our job involves dealing with distributed systems, stream processing, ml modeling and computation at tens of PB Scale. By providing our users with ML products/tools, shared frameworks, and ML services, we enable our company to validate strategic decisions, make smarter choices, and react to the fast-changing world. descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NUMA

Hey there! We’re Numa, a forward-thinking hospitality brand redefining how people discover cities. We create spaces where simplicity meets innovation, offering thoughtfully designed rooms, studios, and apartments in the heart of Europe’s most vibrant neighbourhoods.
We’re not just transforming the guest experience—we’re revolutionizing the hospitality industry from the inside out. Our cutting-edge technology streamlines operations, delivering unparalleled value with no hidden fees—just real, quality experiences.
At Numa, we believe that travel should be curious and authentic, and we bring those same values to our work culture. As part of our team, you’ll experience a dynamic and supportive environment where creativity thrives, and your contributions make a real impact. We’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where every voice is valued, and different perspectives fuel our innovation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a highly experienced Product Manager to lead the development of numa’s in-house Revenue Management System (RMS – the platform that automates room pricing and forecasting decisions).

This is a foundational role — you will set the product vision, define the roadmap, and build the team from the ground up. You’ll work closely with engineers and data scientists to develop algorithms and automation that improve pricing performance across numa’s large, fast-growing European hospitality portfolio with hundreds of millions in annual revenue. 

You will lead a culture of experimentation and controlled risk-taking, continuously testing pricing hypotheses through A/B experiments and agile iteration. Your mission: make numa’s pricing engine the fastest-learning and most adaptive RMS in hospitality.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own the RMS roadmap – define, prioritize, and deliver features that improve pricing performance, automation, and transparency.
  • Build and lead a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and analysts – you’ll be involved in hiring and shaping key roles.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation – design and evaluate A/B tests to validate pricing strategies and model changes.
  • Drive controlled risk-taking – balance bold pricing moves with measurable impact and learning.
  • Translate commercial strategy into product design – turn elasticity, segmentation, and revenue goals into production-ready pricing algorithms and core business rules.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Leadership to align on business strategy and portfolio pricing.
  • Integrate external data sources (OTAs, competitor rates, demand signals, campaigns) to enhance pricing accuracy.
  • Work fast and agile – build MVPs, measure, iterate, and scale proven solutions.
  • Ensure transparency – all pricing decisions must be explainable and data-backed.

Key Success Metrics
  • RevPAR uplift: +3–5% vs. off-the-shelf RMS alternatives (RevPAR = Revenue per Available Room).
  • Length of Stay (LOS): >3.5 nights average.
  • Direct Share & Demand Diversification: ≥50% of total bookings.
  • Corporate Business Share: ≥25% of revenue via optimized corporate pricing strategy.
  • Pricing Automation: >90% of inventory priced dynamically.
  • Forecast Accuracy: +-3% forecast accuracy

Launch Automation: Rateplan & Pricing setup of a new property within 24h

  • Experimentation Speed: ≤2-week A/B test cycle from idea to result.

ABOUT YOU
  • 8+ years in Product Management, with 3+ years leading cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience building pricing, yield management, or forecasting systems (hospitality, travel, mobility, or marketplaces).
  • Deep knowledge of revenue management principles – elasticity, booking curves, segmentation.
  • Deep Analytical & Econometric Grounding: Proven ability to structure complex, multi-variable optimization problems and define A/B testing methodologies for causal inference. A Master's degree or strong applied experience in Economics, Econometrics, or a highly quantitative field is strongly preferred.
  • Technical fluency – comfortable with data pipelines, ML models, and APIs. Experience should include practical application of time-series forecasting and Tree-based algorithms (e.g., XGBoost), and an understanding of when complex deep learning models are an inappropriate overhead.
  • Strong– experienced in testing frameworks and data validation.
  • Excellent communicator – can bridge business goals with technical delivery.
  • Entrepreneurial and proactive – thrives in high-speed, high-ownership environments.

Nice to Have
  • Experience in hospitality tech (RMS, PMS, OTA, channel management).
  • Background in SQL, Python, or Looker.
  • Experience with AI and machine learning–driven automation.
  • Track record of building products and teams from zero to scale.

Why Join numa
  • Build numa’s proprietary Revenue Management System (RMS), you are at the forefront of innovation in the hospitality market.
  • Shape pricing strategy and experimentation culture for one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality brands.
  • Lead a highly skilled team where speed, experimentation, and measurable learning are core values.
  • Drive tangible commercial impact and innovation in a data-first environment.
  • Ambitious but empathic leadership, lean structures and fast decisions. Our product and tech teams are empowered to drive impact.

ABOUT OUR OFFER
  • Empower your career: Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your ideas help shape our future. Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and build a fulfilling career path.
  • Experience our brand: Immerse yourself in the Numa lifestyle with a complimentary stay. Share the love with friends and family through exclusive discounts on our stylish apartments. Connect with a global community of colleagues at our inspiring team-building events.

Numa values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at our company means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognised, appreciated, respected and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilise each person’s talents and strengths. We therefore welcome applications from people of all races, ethnicities, disability statuses, ages, religions, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

For more information on the processing of your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

title: Wissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in Neurorobotics (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Richte dich neu aus. Auf deine Zukunft. Mit velp TEC.velp TEC ist ein auf innovative Technologien ausgerichtetes Weiterbildungsinstitut, das Erfahrungen aus Wirtschaft, Zukunftsforschung und neuen Bildungsansätzen verbindet. Wir unterstützen Menschen durch unsere Bildungsangebote praxisnah dabei, ihre Fähigkeiten für künftige Zeiten zu stärken und damit aktiv ihren Lebensweg zu gestalten. In unserem Handeln legen wir Wert auf gesellschaftliche Verantwortung, Fortschritt und Selbstbestimmung. Bereit für eine neue Mission? Dann entdecke jetzt deine Zukunftsperspektive bei velp TEC und werde Teil unseres multiprofessionellen und diversen Teams. Was deine Aufgaben sein werden Content-Produktion: Erstellung fachlich und wissenschaftlich fundierter Inhalte für den Bildungsbereich Neurorobotics. Inhaltliche Umsetzung: Ausarbeitung der Inhalte auf Basis definierter Modulbeschreibungen, Themencluster und Lernelemente. Text- & Formatvielfalt: Erstellung von Fach- und Reader-Texten, Video- und Skriptinhalten, Fallstudien, Forschungsbeispielen sowie Transfer-, Reflexions-, Projekt-, Portfolio- und Kompetenzaufgaben. Thematische Mitarbeit: Inhaltliche Mitarbeit in mehreren Themenfeldern der Neurorobotik, unter anderem Neurokognition, neuronale Simulation, Lern- und Adaptionsmechanismen, Reinforcement Learning, Multi-Agent-Systeme, Neurorobotik, Sensorik, Robotik und Regelung, Bildverarbeitung, mobile und humanoide Robotik, Modellbildung, Optimierung, maschinelles Lernen, eingebettete und verteilte Systeme sowie aktuelle Forschungstrends in KI, Robotik und Informatik. Qualitätssicherung: Sicherstellung fachlicher Korrektheit, wissenschaftlicher Stringenz sowie hoher inhaltlicher Qualität und Aktualität. Abstimmung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Qualitätssicherung sowie thematischen Ansprechpartnerinnen und Ansprechpartnern. Didaktische Mitgestaltung: Aktives Mitdenken bei Struktur, Dramaturgie und didaktischer Aufbereitung der Inhalte. Arbeitsanspruch: Hoher Anspruch an fachliche Tiefe, Präzision, Nachvollziehbarkeit sowie Qualität und Aktualität der Inhalte. Das solltest du mitbringen Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Informatik, Robotik, Künstlicher Intelligenz, Neuroinformatik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Technischer Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Fachlicher Schwerpunkt: Solides Verständnis mindestens eines Kernbereichs, z. B. KI und Machine Learning, Robotik und Regelung oder neurokognitive Modelle. Sprachkompetenz: Idealerweise sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sonst mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse, da Module und Fachliteratur überwiegend englischsprachig sind. Praxiserfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrung in Robotik, KI, Simulation oder Softwareentwicklung. Content-Erfahrung: Erfahrung in der Erstellung fachlicher oder wissenschaftsnaher Inhalte. Programmierkenntnisse: Programmierkenntnisse in mindestens einer relevanten Sprache, z. B. Python, C/C++, MATLAB oder vergleichbar. Was dich bei velp TEC erwartet Flexibilität: Du hast einen Arzttermin, musst deine Kinder zur Kita oder Schule bringen oder hast einen anderen wichtigen Termin? Kein Problem! Bei uns hast du flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten. Eigenverantwortung & Hands-On-Mentalität: Täglich erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche Herausforderungen, bei denen du ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung zeigen kannst. Du hast eine kreative Idee oder einen Verbesserungsvorschlag? Wir sind immer offen für Innovationen und freuen uns über einen Blick über den Tellerrand. Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten: Du erhältst kostenlosen Zugang zu unseren internen Weiterbildungsangeboten, die dich beruflich weiterbringen. Dafür stehen dir jährlich drei „Educational Days“ zur Verfügung, die du für deine Weiterbildung nutzen kannst. Firmenfitness & Wellness: Deine Gesundheit und dein Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen. Über unseren Partner EGYM Wellpass hast du Zugang zu über 9.000 Fitness- und Yogastudios, Schwimmbädern, Wellnessangeboten sowie Crossfit- und Boulderhallen in Deutschland und Österreich. Ehrenamtliches Engagement: Wir unterstützen dein soziales Engagement und honorieren deine ehrenamtliche Tätigkeit mit einem zusätzlichen Sonderurlaubstag pro Jahr. Betriebliche Vorsorge: Deine Zukunft und Gesundheit sind uns wichtig. Daher bieten wir dir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung an. Spaß & Freude im Team: Wir wissen, dass persönlicher Austausch wichtig ist. Bei uns erlebst du eine offene Duz-Kultur und regelmäßige Teamevents. Rückfragen? Schreib uns einfach an karriere@velptec.de – wir freuen uns auf Deine Nachricht!

descriptionHtml:
Mode of Employment: Fixed Term / Full-Time; (35 hours / week)

Are you ready to pioneer the future of AI at Siemens? Join us in MCH P for a Mandatory Internship focusing on Code Models, Synthetic Data Generation & RL Post-Training and transform the way we develop technology!

What We Offer You

  • Exciting insights into various business areas and fields of activity
  • Challenging and practical project tasks where you can apply and expand your knowledge
  • Individual support and mentoring from experienced mentors
  • The opportunity to actively contribute to ongoing projects

You'll make an impact by

  • You conduct research on code models focusing on synthetic data generation and reinforcement learning (RL) post-training to enhance model performance
  • Following this, you design and implement pipelines to efficiently generate and utilize synthetic data for training purposes
  • In addition, you develop and evaluate advanced RL methods tailored for the post-training optimization of code models
  • Throughout your internship, you collaborate closely with data & AI scientists to drive innovative solutions in the field of machine learning
  • Lastly, you document your findings comprehensively and share them within the team to foster knowledge exchange and collective growth

This Is How You'll Win Us Over

  • Education: You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field
  • Experience and Skills:
    • You possess strong Python programming skills; knowledge of C++ or Java is a plus
    • You have a solid understanding of machine learning and deep learning concepts
    • You are familiar with LLM frameworks such as Hugging Face
    • You demonstrate a strong interest in reinforcement learning and synthetic data generation
    • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ways of Working: You are capable of working both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
  • Languages: Proficient in English
You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Your individual personality and perspective are important to us. We create a working environment that reflects the diversity of the society and support you in your personal and professional development. Let’s get to know your authentic personality and create a better future together with us. As an equal-opportunity employer we are happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.

About Us

The world never stands still. And new challenges arise every day. With a passion for questioning things, for supplying ideas, and intelligently driving things forward we are helping society move towards a smarter tomorrow. Be it with technologies that reduce carbon emissions in cities or hyperintelligent robots. This is how we are able, to tackle the most important projects and push them forward together. Help us shape the future.

www.siemens.de/careers – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.

FAQ – if you need further information on the application process.

If you have more questions please contact: www.siemens.com/fragenzurbewerbung

Unsere Produkte sind dabei so vielfältig wie die Karrierewege, die wir bieten: Von kundenspezifischen Gleitsichtgläsern bis hin zu preisgekrönten Messsystemen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte eine Zukunft, in der klarer Durchblick und beruflicher Erfolg Hand in Hand gehen.
Deine Rolle
Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, Studium und Praxis optimal miteinander zu verbinden und aktiv an spannenden Projekten mitzuarbeiten. So sammelst Du wertvolle Erfahrungen, baust Dein Netzwerk auf und entwickelst Dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiter.
Wir suchen einen engagierten und motivierten Masterstudenten (m/w/x) zur Durchführung einer Masterthesis im Bereich der Bilddatenanalyse. Ziel der Arbeit ist es, eine systematische Methode zur Bewertung von Bildern zu entwickeln, die auf verschiedenen Qualitätskriterien basiert. Diese Arbeit wird einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Bildverarbeitungstechnologien leisten.
Dein Profil
Ein aktuelles Masterstudium in Informatik, Machine Learning, Digital Engineering, AI Technologies oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang
Ausgeprägtes Interesse an Bildverarbeitung, Datenanalyse und modernen Technologien
Selbstständige, strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise
Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie Python, idealerweise mit praktischer Erfahrung in Projekten
Klingt spannend? Dann werde Teil von #teamZEISS und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft! Reiche uns hierfür bitte Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse etc.) ein.
Your ZEISS Recruiting Team
Selina Safradin

title: Principal AI Developer Technology Engineer
description: We’re currently seeking a Developer Technology Engineer, Artificial Intelligence. Would you enjoy researching parallel algorithms to accelerate AI workloads on advanced computer architectures? Do you find it rewarding to identify and eliminate system bottlenecks to achieve the best possible performance on pioneering computer hardware? Could you be thrilled about an opportunity to partner with the developer community, working at the forefront of technology breakthroughs that contribute to the success of an industry leader like NVIDIA? If so, the Developer Technology Team invites you to consider this role. What You Will Be Doing In this position, you will research and develop techniques to GPU accelerate workloads in deep learning, machine learning or other AI domains. Work directly with other technical experts in their fields (industry and academia) to perform in-depth analysis and optimization of complex AI and HPC algorithms to ensure optimal AI solutions on modern CPU and GPU architectures. Publish and/or present discovered optimization techniques in developer blogs or relevant conferences to engage and educate the developer community. Influence the design of next-generation hardware architectures, software, and programming models in collaboration with research, hardware, system software, libraries, and tools teams at NVIDIA. What We Need To See An advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree (or equivalent experience). You have 15+ years of relevant experience in software development or research work. Programming fluency in C/C++ with a deep understanding of algorithms and software development. A background that includes parallel programming, e.g., CUDA, Open ACC, Open MP, MPI, pthreads, etc. Hands on experience doing low-level performance optimizations. In-depth expertise with CPU and GPU architecture fundamentals. Effective communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, good time management, and prioritization skills. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Expertise in parallelization and performance optimization of Deep Learning models arising from Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Recommender Systems, etc. Excellent understanding of linear algebra. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you a creative and autonomous computer scientist with a genuine passion for parallel computing? If so, we want to hear from you. Come, join our AI Compute Dev Tech team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field. NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.#deeplearning JR2011952

Do you find it rewarding to identify and eliminate system bottlenecks to achieve the best possible performance on pioneering computer hardware? Could you be thrilled about an opportunity to partner with the developer community, working at the forefront of technology breakthroughs that contribute to the success of an industry leader like NVIDIA? If so, the Developer Technology Team invites you to consider this role.

What You Will Be Doing

  • In this position, you will research and develop techniques to GPU accelerate workloads in deep learning, machine learning or other AI domains.
  • Work directly with other technical experts in their fields (industry and academia) to perform in-depth analysis and optimization of complex AI and HPC algorithms to ensure optimal AI solutions on modern CPU and GPU architectures.
  • Publish and/or present discovered optimization techniques in developer blogs or relevant conferences to engage and educate the developer community.
  • Influence the design of next-generation hardware architectures, software, and programming models in collaboration with research, hardware, system software, libraries, and tools teams at NVIDIA.

What We Need To See

  • An advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree (or equivalent experience).
  • You have 15+ years of relevant experience in software development or research work.
  • Programming fluency in C/C++ with a deep understanding of algorithms and software development.
  • A background that includes parallel programming, e.g., CUDA, OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI, pthreads, etc.
  • Hands on experience doing low-level performance optimizations.
  • In-depth expertise with CPU and GPU architecture fundamentals.
  • Effective communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, good time management, and prioritization skills.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Expertise in parallelization and performance optimization of Deep Learning models arising from Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Recommender Systems, etc.
  • Excellent understanding of linear algebra.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you a creative and autonomous computer scientist with a genuine passion for parallel computing? If so, we want to hear from you. Come, join our AI Compute DevTech team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

We are looking for motivated students in the area of Data & AI for an internship, a bachelor’s or master’s thesis, or a working student position to support our team in Ulm.

Your Responsibilities
  • You're excited to contribute to meaningful projects and collaborate with colleagues from different business areas

  • Extract meaningful insights from large datasets

  • A strong motivation to dive into new areas of knowledge—both technical and domain-specific—and to actively contribute to our evolving projects

  • High degree of motivation & ability to collaborate in a team
  • Good practical skills in programming (e.g. Python or SQL), data structures and algorithms
  • Good theoretical in data science, data analysis, visualization or data engineering
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills in German & English
  • We offer flexibility for remote work, while also valuing regular on-site collaboration at our Ulm office

Our offer
At the Liebherr Digital Development Center, we are working on a wide range of digital solutions from cloud applications to embedded software to data analysis. As an intern/working student (m/f/d) in the Data & AI team, you will be able to gain a deep insight into cutting edge technologies in areas such as big data, natural language processing or generative AI. At the same time, you will enjoy a modern and comforting work environment with enthusiastic colleagues in our new Ulm offices, allowing you to do your best work with great support from everyone around you. While we offer flexibility for remote work, we also value regular on-site collaboration at our Ulm office.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Lena Dangel.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description: Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division Enabling the movement toward advanced chip design, KLA's Measurement, Analytics and Control group (MACH) is looking for the best and brightest research scientists, software engineers, application development engineers and senior product technology process engineers to join our team. The MACH team's mission is to collaborate with our customers to innovate technologies and solutions that detect and control highly complex process variations—at their source—rather than compensate for them at later stages of the manufacturing process. With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Our MACH team develops leading-edge solutions for patterning process analytics and control technologies, thereby providing customers with critical insight at the feature level, field level and cross-wafer analysis. Our teams also develop advanced modeling simulation, data analytics and process control modeling technologies. As a member of the MACH team, you’ll be joining the most sophisticated and successful process-control company in the semiconductor industry--working across functions to solve the most complex technical problems in the digital age. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications MACH, the software data analytics division in KLA is looking for a passionate and motivated Senior AI Engineer with experience developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring Agentic AI applications that go beyond traditional machine and deep learning. In this role, the candidate will be responsible for working with the division’s AI Working Group integrating Agentic AI across various products to solve complex challenges in semiconductor manufacturing. The candidate will be involved in technical/architectural design, identifying suitable technology stacks, and hands-on development and will be working with a talented cross-functional teams integrating these intelligent agents into applications and workflows that enhance efficiency, quality, and innovation. Responsibilities: Architect and implement agentic AI solutions for semiconductor applications Develop multi-agent systems that collaborate across semiconductor domains Integrate reasoning, planning, and reinforcement learning into AI workflows Collaborate with hardware, software, and data teams to ensure seamless deployment, usability and user-experience Continuously evaluate emerging technologies in agent-based AI and apply them to real-world semiconductor challenges. Skills & Experience: 5+ years in AI/ML development, with strong exposure to agent-based systems or reinforcement learning, having designed, evaluated, deployed, and monitored such applications Experience with LLM pre-training is optional, but a significant advantage At least 5 years of total post-graduation working experience in software engineering, preferably including Machine Learning and Deep Learning Proficiency in key programming languages and APIs such as Python, JavaScript, Angular/Vue, C/C++, PyTorch Experience developing web-based front-ends Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and data pipelines is a plus Understanding of cloud platforms and MLOps for scalable AI deployment. Strong communication skills and ability to easily work in a dynamic cross-functional environment Strong ability to be flexible with evolving requirements and onboard latest technologies and models Academic Background: Master’s degree or Ph D in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field Minor in Mathematics is optional, but preferred Minimum Qualifications Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division

Enabling the movement toward advanced chip design, KLA's Measurement, Analytics and Control group (MACH) is looking for the best and brightest research scientists, software engineers, application development engineers and senior product technology process engineers to join our team. The MACH team's mission is to collaborate with our customers to innovate technologies and solutions that detect and control highly complex process variations—at their source—rather than compensate for them at later stages of the manufacturing process. With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Our MACH team develops leading-edge solutions for patterning process analytics and control technologies, thereby providing customers with critical insight at the feature level, field level and cross-wafer analysis. Our teams also develop advanced modeling simulation, data analytics and process control modeling technologies. As a member of the MACH team, you’ll be joining the most sophisticated and successful process-control company in the semiconductor industry--working across functions to solve the most complex technical problems in the digital age.

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

MACH, the software data analytics division in KLA is looking for a passionate and motivated Senior AI Engineer with experience developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring Agentic AI applications that go beyond traditional machine and deep learning. In this role, the candidate will be responsible for working with the division’s AI Working Group integrating Agentic AI across various products to solve complex challenges in semiconductor manufacturing. The candidate will be involved in technical/architectural design, identifying suitable technology stacks, and hands-on development and will be working with a talented cross-functional teams integrating these intelligent agents into applications and workflows that enhance efficiency, quality, and innovation.

Responsibilities:

  • Architect and implement agentic AI solutions for semiconductor applications
  • Develop multi-agent systems that collaborate across semiconductor domains
  • Integrate reasoning, planning, and reinforcement learning into AI workflows
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, and data teams to ensure seamless deployment, usability and user-experience
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies in agent-based AI and apply them to real-world semiconductor challenges.


Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years in AI/ML development, with strong exposure to agent-based systems or reinforcement learning, having designed, evaluated, deployed, and monitored such applications
  • Experience with LLM pre-training is optional, but a significant advantage
  • At least 5 years of total post-graduation working experience in software engineering, preferably including Machine Learning and Deep Learning
  • Proficiency in key programming languages and APIs such as Python, JavaScript, Angular/Vue, C/C++, PyTorch
  • Experience developing web-based front-ends
  • Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and data pipelines is a plus
  • Understanding of cloud platforms and MLOps for scalable AI deployment.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to easily work in a dynamic cross-functional environment
  • Strong ability to be flexible with evolving requirements and onboard latest technologies and models


Academic Background:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minor in Mathematics is optional, but preferred


Minimum Qualifications

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer

Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

title: Administrative Assistant (part-time, permanent) for the Research Department “Machine Learning in Chemistry”
description: The MPI for Polymer Research (MPI-P) ranks among the top research centers in the field of polymer science worldwide. The MPI-P offers ideal conditions for conducting outstanding research. The institute combines all the necessary specialized expertise – from the creative design of new materials, their synthesis in the lab to their physical characterization as well as the theoretical understanding of polymer characteristics. We Are Looking For Administrative Assistant (part‑time, permanent) for the Research Department “Machine Learning in Chemistry”Start date: as soon as possible, by mutual agreement. Aufgaben General secretarial and administrative duties for the Research Department, including organising business trips for group members. Technical and organisational support for meetings and small events (room bookings, catering coordination, participant communication). Maintaining regular contact with the local administrative units of the Max Planck Institute and the general administration of the Max Planck Society. Local administrative support for visitors and new group members (e.g., hiring-related processes in coordination with administration and assistance in finding accommodation). Reporting to the Scientific Coordinator of the Department. Profil Completed vocational training as an office administrator or comparable qualification, or a completed bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or initial professional experience in an assistant, office management, or administration role, ideally in an academic or research environment. Fluency in written and spoken German and English. Excellent organisational skills, a strong eye for detail, and a reliable, deadline-oriented way of working. Confident use of common office software and online tools; openness to participating in and organising online meetings. A pronounced service orientation, strong communication skills, and a cooperative team spirit. Wir bieten A modern, centrally located workplace with excellent public transport connections in a highly international working environment. A varied role at the interface between science and administration with scope for independent work and further development of your skills. Remuneration according to the German public service pay scale (TVö D Bund, up to EG9), depending on qualifications and experience, including the usual social benefits of the public sector. All communication, including the interview, will be done in English. The Max Planck Society policy aims at increasing the proportion of women in the areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore encouraged to apply. A childcare facility is directly attached to the institute. The Max Planck Society is striving to employ more disabled people. Applications from people with disabilities are particularly valued. Handicapped applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential treatment. Important note Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered. LNKD1_DE

title: Knowledge Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Als Knowledge Engineer tauchst du in unseren Projekten tief in die Wissenswelten unserer Kunden ein, modellierst komplexe Zusammenhänge und entwickelst intelligente Systeme, die Wissen einfach und zuverlässig zugänglich machen. Ob beim Aufbau von Wissensgraphen, beim Entwurf von RAG-Systemen oder bei der Integration modernster KI-Technologien – du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und deinem Team zusammen, um Wissen in greifbare Lösungen zu verwandeln. Wesentliche Aufgaben, mit individueller Schwerpunktsetzung:Wissens- & Datenmodellierung: Wissensgraphen, semantische Datenmodelle, Vektor- und relationale Datenbanken entwerfen, entwickeln, befüllen und pflegen. Ontologien & Metadaten: Gemeinsam mit Fachexperten präzise Ontologien, Taxonomien und kontrollierte Vokabulare erstellen. Abfragen & Datenoptimierung: Effiziente SPARQL-Abfragen entwickeln, Daten transformieren und Modelle kontinuierlich optimieren. Beratung & Modellverbesserung: Bestehende Wissensmodelle analysieren, anpassen und optimieren, um neue Anforderungen zu erfüllen. Data Engineering Pipelines: Data Pipelines in Unternehmens-, Kunden- und Cloud-Infrastrukturen entwickeln, betreiben und orchestrieren. AI & Machine Learning: LLMs, Chatbots, Agenten und RAG-/Graph RAG-Systeme integrieren, testen und optimieren. Technologie-Scouting: Neue Technologien evaluieren und sinnvoll in bestehende Architekturen integrieren. Komplexe Problemlösung: Herausforderungen analysieren und innovative, tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln. Dein Profil Ausbildung & Qualifikation Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Informationswissenschaft, Wissensmanagement, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung. Zusätzliche Zertifikate/Qualifikationen in Data Science, Machine Learning, Wissensmodellierung oder Projektmanagement bringen dich bei uns weiter. Berufserfahrung Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Knowledge Engineering, Wissensmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Erfahrung in Projekten mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams. Technische Skills Fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenbanken, Ontologien, semantischen Technologien und SPARQL. Erfahrung mit Tools wie Pool Party, AVM, Anzo Graph DB oder Ontotext Graph DB. Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse (Programmieren, Debuggen, Deployen). Know-how in LLMs, Chatbots, Agenten, RAG, AI-Klassifizierung und Machine Learning Pipelines. Warum wir? Abwechslungsreiche Projekte: Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen Projekten in internationalen Teams und mit namhaften Kunden aus verschiedenen Branchen. Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Genieße die Möglichkeit bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche im Mobile Office zu arbeiten. Erholungsurlaub: Bei uns hast Du 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub pro Jahr. Wir wissen, wie wichtig es ist, sich zu erholen und neue Energie zu tanken. Unterstützendes Team: Freue dich auf ein hilfsbereites Team aus erfahrenen Kollegen und flachen Hierarchien. Wir arbeiten zusammen in einer positiven und kooperativen Atmosphäre, in der jeder zählt. Attraktives Gehalt: Wir honorieren deine Leistung und Erfahrung mit einem attraktiven Gehalt. Bei uns wirst du fair entlohnt. Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Unsere Büros sind modern und nachhaltig gestaltet und wir arbeiten mit neuesten Technologien und modernsten Arbeitsmitteln, die dir helfen, effizient und produktiv zu sein. Job Rad: Nutze das Job Rad-Programm und lease ein Fahrrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen. Pendle umweltfreundlich zur Arbeit oder genieße deine Freizeit auf dem Rad. Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket: Wir unterstützen deine umweltfreundliche Mobilität! Unsere Mitarbeiter erhalten einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, damit du bequem und kostengünstig den öffentlichen Nah- und Fernverkehr nutzen kannst. Regelmäßige Teamevents: Wir glauben an den Wert von Teamzusammenhalt und Spaß. Deshalb veranstalten wir regelmäßig Teamevents wie Sommerpartys und Cocktailabende, bei denen du deine Kollegen besser kennenlernen und gemeinsam feiern kannst. Ontologien & Metadaten: Gemeinsam mit Fachexperten präzise Ontologien, Taxonomien und kontrollierte Vokabulare erstellen.
Abfragen & Datenoptimierung: Effiziente SPARQL-Abfragen entwickeln, Daten transformieren und Modelle kontinuierlich optimieren.
Beratung & Modellverbesserung: Bestehende Wissensmodelle analysieren, anpassen und optimieren, um neue Anforderungen zu erfüllen.
Data Engineering Pipelines: Data Pipelines in Unternehmens-, Kunden- und Cloud-Infrastrukturen entwickeln, betreiben und orchestrieren.
AI & Machine Learning: LLMs, Chatbots, Agenten und RAG-/GraphRAG-Systeme integrieren, testen und optimieren.
Technologie-Scouting: Neue Technologien evaluieren und sinnvoll in bestehende Architekturen integrieren.
Komplexe Problemlösung: Herausforderungen analysieren und innovative, tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln.

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Informationswissenschaft, Wissensmanagement, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung.
Zusätzliche Zertifikate/Qualifikationen in Data Science, Machine Learning, Wissensmodellierung oder Projektmanagement bringen dich bei uns weiter.
Berufserfahrung
Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Knowledge Engineering, Wissensmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
Erfahrung in Projekten mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams.
Technische Skills
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenbanken, Ontologien, semantischen Technologien und SPARQL.
Erfahrung mit Tools wie PoolParty, AVM, AnzoGraph DB oder Ontotext GraphDB.
Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse (Programmieren, Debuggen, Deployen).
Know-how in LLMs, Chatbots, Agenten, RAG, AI-Klassifizierung und Machine Learning Pipelines.
Warum wir?
Abwechslungsreiche Projekte: Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen Projekten in internationalen Teams und mit namhaften Kunden aus verschiedenen Branchen.

Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Unsere Büros sind modern und nachhaltig gestaltet und wir arbeiten mit neuesten Technologien und modernsten Arbeitsmitteln, die dir helfen, effizient und produktiv zu sein.

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

The AI Research Division of Agile Robots is looking for a motivated and experienced (Senior) LLM / AI Engineer (m/f/d) Predictive Maintenance Agent. You will design and build AI agents that enable factory operators and engineers to analyze, understand, and optimize complex production systems using natural language. The role focuses on production-grade LLM-based systems that translate user intent into reliable data analysis, integrate with factory data pipelines, and support predictive intelligence use cases in real industrial environments.

Your Responsibilities

  • AI Agent Design: Design and implement LLM-based agents that perform multi-step reasoning, tool invocation, and structured data analysis with reliability and determinism.
  • Data Analysis Automation: Build systems that translate natural-language requests into complex analytical workflows over factory and production-line data.
  • System Integration: Integrate AI agents with internal data collection, storage, and monitoring systems used in industrial production environments.
  • Production Readiness: Ensure AI systems are testable, observable, and maintainable through robust evaluation, monitoring, and versioning practices.
  • Predictive Intelligence: Support predictive maintenance and anomaly detection use cases by enabling data-driven analysis and model interaction through AI agents.
  • Deployment Collaboration: Work closely with other teams during on-site deployments to validate, refine, and operate AI systems under real-world constraints.

Essential Skills

  • Python Engineering: Strong Python skills for production systems, including testing, packaging, and maintainable codebases.
  • Applied Data Analysis & ML: Proven experience with applied data analysis and machine learning, including statistics, data exploration, model tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
  • LLM Agent Development: Hands-on experience building LLM-based agents involving tool calling, code generation, multi-step reasoning, reliability or guardrails, and agent efficiency.
  • Agent Frameworks & RAG: Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent frameworks, and with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.
  • Multimodal Data Analysis: Familiarity with time-series analysis, image processing, and multimodal LLM or VLM agents involving text and images.
  • Data Systems & Operations: Strong database fundamentals and SQL, experience with natural-language-to-database querying (NL2SQL or semantic querying), and familiarity with MLOps or LLMOps practices such as evaluation, monitoring, tracing, and versioning.
  • Deployment Readiness: Willingness to travel for on-site deployments.

Beneficial Skills

  • Industrial Predictive Maintenance: Experience with predictive maintenance or anomaly detection in industrial environments, including multimodal data sources.
  • System Integration: Experience designing or integrating REST-based APIs in production systems.
  • Language Skills: Chinese language proficiency.

What we offer

  • Dynamic high-tech company combined with financial soundness and world class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities in the context of our continued growth.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program that covers health, mobility and learning with 100 € net per month.
  • Modern office facilites with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment.

Apply for this job

About Us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 2300 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.
